| Hello Peter, I'm **Pasquale Scopelliti** , and I had the distinct joy of interviewing Ammon for his take on the [**10 Planks of the MAGA Platform**](https://www.votebundy.com/media/interviews/maga?do=intro). When I found Ammon's [Keep Idaho IDAHO Plan](https://www.votebundy.com/kii), I knew I had to interview him.

Introducing myself a bit, as an analyst I served the Trump Campaign in 2016, working closely together with General Mike Flynn. I'm active in social media, with Twitter being my main platform, where I am [@ThyConsigliori](https://twitter.com/ThyConsigliori). I regularly post threads there, and have posted thoughts on my interview with Ammon. In 2018, my wife Kate and I published a book, [America First: The MAGA Manifesto](https://www.amazon.com/America-First-Manifesto-Handbook-Midterms-ebook/dp/B07D1T3838/), in which the 10 Planks of the MAGA Movement are laid out.

Ammon is the most unique candidate on the field in America today. His historical, philosophical, and religious dedication is only matched by the seriousness of his vision and the playful joy of his creative, fresh solutions.

I hope you enjoy watching these interviews as much as I enjoyed doing them. As Idaho's next governor, Ammon is about to make his mark upon America, and upon history. That's what you'll hear below.-Pat

This crucial Senate just shifted from "toss up" to "lean Dem." | | | Hi Peter, with only six weeks to go before the crucial November congressional elections, Cook Political Report just moved Democratic US Senator Mark Kelly's re-election race in Arizona from "toss-up" to "leans Dem," following Kelly taking a slight lead in a number of polls. **This is huge news, as Kelly's race is crucial to Democrats retaining control of the Senate, and preventing Mitch McConnell from stopping President Biden's agenda in its tracks.** Kelly's "100% pro-life" opponent, Blake Masters, a big MAGA supporter who enjoys the support of both Donald Trump and far-right billionaire Peter Thiel (who wrote in 2009 that women's suffrage was a bad thing), just wiped his campaign Web site of most of its tough anti-abortion language -- including language that just the other day detailed his support for "a federal personhood law (ideally a Constitutional amendment) that recognizes that unborn babies are human beings that may not be killed." According to [NBC News](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDNClnthegaegMbidLNE7CRFWiiI1zfV5eoRxwQO64Ro5JlYSzYwuwzOZ3RvgZ0KTwaDdC_CU0GBmb1caL91Mdh_77B5upDT_ewWrrf4teKOyweJ5Kl7XUixe5ol91naF2RgMwH1HKH6TqpuVaqDkCVfNdZDlwSGWz0F5YNf8hgQOMv4IADNMc009M5YBx7brtNFa3GOj3TUyRvRSHfXF15mPa224XWz07kErkA34ol05xNZH83V8TFz2wQB7yCwCnhE2liq-nq6dXmc27q1Hajp9LRZV2-CAEqzx9T4D7VzCeuhEGeeFeAnQGkIxUA4_w9NHkjnJvGun_eKDgk0WexjDRWpnCMwHNy_nrEtTAla91ws3071P5hQnYUzSY-Mb5A/3pt/ecmsLR9rQOWqwkbK1HBEpw/h0/FFRCpNH1_WnH-B3QdXr5sPxHi81wjY8eIT0jeXJlWVY), "Masters previously expressed support for 'the Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act, the Born Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act, the SAVE Moms and Babies Act, and other pro-life legislation.' name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61403985:JJxkcfVND:m:1:3334294963:1C5E5FB47AC43F84922FF9E89E7AB94F:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61403985:JJxkcfVND:m:1:3334294963:1C5E5FB47AC43F84922FF9E89E7AB94F:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61403985:JJxkcfVND:m:1:3334294963:1C5E5FB47AC43F84922FF9E89E7AB94F:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61403985:JJxkcfVND:m:1:3334294963:1C5E5FB47AC43F84922FF9E89E7AB94F:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61403985:JJxkcfVND:m:1:3334294963:1C5E5FB47AC43F84922FF9E89E7AB94F:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61403985:JJxkcfVND:m:1:3334294963:1C5E5FB47AC43F84922FF9E89E7AB94F:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation.
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413428:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413429:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413430:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413431:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413432:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413433:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413434:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413435:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413427:6JX7MfV6N:m:1:3317145305:CEC5C602E37ACCC7E4D431DAE8789E28:r)

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation</

Peter,

**_It 's been a tough morning._**

It's not fun to bring you bad news, but I need to let you know - my finance team told me that we're not on track to hit our September goal! This is a HUGE issue because all our numbers will be made public in just a couple of weeks.

The end of September is the end of the quarter, and every donor's name will be available. I really hope we see your name there, Peter. Your help makes such a difference.

On top of that, my friend and Conservative Leader, Ted Budd, called me to tell me he is not going to reach his goal.

Democrats are going to GLOAT when they see that Conservatives are STRUGGLING. We can't let this happen. We cannot let them win.

With less than 2 months until the election, this is not the time to lose ground. [**_Can you chip in any amount right now to help us reach our goal?_**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61413405:J0LgMfVNv:m:1:3331421248:7D82F3C254E353C402F1B01A8DC85365:r)

body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6004%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=CwqkAO2qfuhzzPGEomPoBw&sysid=1)
| | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86891%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2GxHdM82mQEXE%2frKH%2fYfiw&sysid=1)
---
|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61414682:JuNYZfVNB:m:1:3253819041:9EAB363F80359984CAF68BE8A5C9D8A7:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $10 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have poured
into pro-abortion groups. Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice
America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to
roughly $2.3 million in just three months.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osJElAPhrN

Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end
abortion, you need to know what's been going on the last few
weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned,
millions of dollars have poured into pro-abortion groups.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL
Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from
$630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every
donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups
accross the country are struggling to keep up as donors have
stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v.
Wade at the end of the battle, when it is just the beginning.

billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and

Why?

years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your

poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother's wombs:
https://give.liveaction.org/stand-up-to-big-abortion/

Your unwavering conviction and

will prevail and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as
we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

name: American Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0853%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=5GIyOrsjzt%2fYT8imMQSnnw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34274%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ALRF0uNhBQT3kXj5K2eTSA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34285%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8BhBIercfFQfZ6E88nfVyw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34285%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8BhBIercfFQfZ6E88nfVyw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Elect Ganahl, a strong woman who will better protect children and families, cut taxes, attack the fentanyl crisis, improve our roads and get students learning to read again. Thank Polis for his service and elect Ganahl." ****\- The Gazette Editorial Board**
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qjhhjjy-ttjjilthht-y/) **" Ganahl will restore Colorado as a family friendly, safe, affordable, low-crime environment known for quality of life not quantity of vice."** [_**Read the full endorsement here.**_](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qjhhjjy-ttjjilthht-j/) **JOIN THE WINNING TEAM:** A HUGE thank you to the 100+ volunteers who came out to support me, Danny, and all of the local Jefferson County candidates!

We can feel this momentum all across the state, let's keep it going! **Sign up to volunteer at[heidiforgov.com/action](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qjhhjjy-ttjjilthht-t/).** [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qjhhjjy-ttjjilthht-i/) I loved being down in Pueblo yesterday for the 25th Annual Chile & Frijoles Festival! The election is just six weeks away, and things are heating up in Pennsylvania's Tenth District. Our opponent, Scott Perry, played a pivotal role in the plot to overturn the 2020 election. He cares more about Donald Trump than he does the needs of his own constituents and the American people, and it's time for him to go!

Glenn Beck: "All three candidates won their race... and they were endorsed by the 1776 Project PAC." Peter, it's only because of the support of patriots like you that we've been able to make so much progress in so little time. [_**_And today, I'm reaching out because we DESPERATELY need your help to support the 300 candidates we're working with this fall._**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61419295:6Kaq4fVNr:m:1:3317145305:0DCFB947A937735B57705F6AB8DFA149:r) You see, the school board candidates we support are conservative average joes. That means that YOUR donation to the 1776 Project PAC is the main source of funding for not just our team- but for all the: mailers, television and radio ads, phone callers, and door knockers for the candidates. Each race costs between $3,500 and $10,000 dollars. That means a donation of ANY AMOUNT could be the difference between winning and losing. I can't stress this enough: your support is the difference between saving this country, or submitting ourselves to a future ruled by a generation of leaders who were raised on hatred for our country, and for American values. [_**So please, Peter, will you chip in $25 or more today?**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61419295:6Kaq4fVNr:m:1:3317145305:0DCFB947A937735B57705F6AB8DFA149:r) Thank you in advance for your support. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 27
PHOTO RELEASE: KELLY LOEFFLER, BURT JONES KICK OFF WOMEN FOR A GREATER GEORGIA COALITION (ATLANTA) - This weekend, former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler and Republican Nominee for Lt. Governor Burt Jones joined over 100 supporters to kick off the Women for a Greater Georgia coalition at Lucky's Burger and Brew in Roswell. The coalition, launched by Citizens for a Greater Georgia, is a statewide outreach effort designed to mobilize women across the state on behalf of Georgia's Republican State Senators, and conservative candidates up and down the ballot.

| | Hello,Public education today is failing our nation's young people-and their parents.As each generation moves on from the public school system, more and more Americans are growing unaware of our country's great history and civic traditions.But unfortunately, civics and history are too often forgotten or overlooked in the 21st century. That's why I am committed to having conversations with thought leaders around the country and providing educational resources for Americans.But an educated citizenry is essential to self-government-and the future of freedom. That's why I've issued a challenge to patriots like you to read-or re-read-the Declaration of Independence as part of our More Perfect Union Project.Because this important historical document is so rich with wisdom and eternal truths, I've asked my team at ACI to put together a helpful guide that offers a clear and exclusive analysis of this piece of history.[And I'm emailing you today to make sure you get a free copy of this latest eBook: _Breaking Down the Declaration_.](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-yBIxDjElNEImdxw)[](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-BIsuwA)
When you read this book, you’ll discover:
* The historical context surrounding the Declaration of Independence and why our Founders drafted it
* The 3 essential elements of the Declaration and what they meant for the establishment of our nation
* How many of King George’s original offenses are being repeated by our own government today

You can get your free copy using this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/breaking-down-the-declaration/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)And I hope you'll share it with your family, friends, and anyone you know in our younger generations.If we're going stop history from repeating itself, it is critical that we educate as many people as possible.I really hope you enjoy this book.Please use this link to get instant access right now: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/breaking-down-the-declaration/](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)Regards,Dr. Ben Carson
American Cornerstone Institute

body:
I have a special request to ask of you.
Wiley Nickel needs your help here in North Carolina’s 13th District. He’s got a $100,000 goal for the month of September, and his opponent Bo Hines is raking in cash from Super PACs and the wealthy GOP donor base.
This is a huge inflection point for Wiley’s campaign, Peter. That’s why I’m urging you to join me in support of Wiley by making a grassroots contribution of $25 to his campaign right away. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2209-q3-wn-eoq?refcode=220927-email-1&amount=25]
I’ve been keeping close tabs on this race and I must say, it’s incredibly impressive what Wiley has been able to do. This district was initially projected as Lean Republican by Fox News, but because of the candidate that Wiley is and the effort you have put in this race is now a toss-up. But he needs your help to close the deal.
National Republicans only need to flip five seats in November to regain control of the House, and Kevin McCarthy and Donald Trump are devoting every resource to help their extremist candidates.
With stakes this high, we can’t afford to take anything for granted. We need grassroots supporters like you to step up and chip in, Peter. So, I’m asking: Can I count on you to chip in $25 right away to help Wiley win his race and protect our Democratic House majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2209-q3-wn-eoq?refcode=220927-email-1&amount=25]
One of my favorite parts about serving as Chairman of the DCCC is getting to know the incredible candidates from around the country.
Peter, Wiley is running a people-powered campaign in NC-13, so he is relying on grassroots supporters like you to chip in what you can. Will you rush a donation of $25 right away to help him flip this seat and help us hold the House Majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2209-q3-wn-eoq?refcode=220927-email-1&amount=25]
Thank you for everything you do,
Sean Patrick Maloney

Fellow American,
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming.
A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately.
Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email.
For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded.
But _why_ would they do such a thing?
By now, I'm sure you have a good guess.
It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy.
So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could.
[**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming — which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=47b3165c83f8434d93a1fc83db1fa6b9&_e=mkljNTcCDK9JHGll__ukGJRE5WzY4quOSzpwi5qHnXvQjrj5eHwb9wxU6jlKedzT7Uh6jvyqyZ-8k-c_R32CguhwAfZVs04MltyODEMc9dWC0ksj-6Gomia4IH28GGwpNGqmbFuq_PUz6zf4WLAMLZ_Gftm2zYFtAlUXTwFGzIUzblzhsOZvrDSEqcS9jcPllS2Se7r7qVDrbk_x5-1-Hop9cKWlYGpO5EV1NMA6260%3D)

[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=47b3165c83f8434d93a1fc83db1fa6b9&_e=mkljNTcCDK9JHGll__ukGJRE5WzY4quOSzpwi5qHnXvQjrj5eHwb9wxU6jlKedzT7Uh6jvyqyZ-8k-c_R32CgqtoQP7IG9UKVTSgXnUhnbdEzoItP5G-CRV3piseqrIjaZuYZBtA-g4Nn4syKJKY_FyaMhy2tfyd_ZbfFU_wcyepQsrmzHA0u_pNHuif_Hm0ZONjWcTI876MKPPl8t_sKHCtRbXmzd4Vr4Fmo-p-y9k%3D)

For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” — so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this.
We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable.
[**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=47b3165c83f8434d93a1fc83db1fa6b9&_e=mkljNTcCDK9JHGll__ukGJRE5WzY4quOSzpwi5qHnXvQjrj5eHwb9wxU6jlKedzT7Uh6jvyqyZ-8k-c_R32CgivqtnGbYNOr2ieOZNkt0V5OJncEUPGluCcm7z7LfFHE9vr94X2kVLgnlucnVr4jgTjFTCGnBUF7fDUTxCt0jHM5ZNfmLCWs_nHCMmj7h_tmDdmvyf_-4djxyC8nmMpl_nIyPM4zyxbW_iVfm4x5Zs8%3D) And remember — you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out.
If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke.
As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.”
But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward.
[**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=47b3165c83f8434d93a1fc83db1fa6b9&_e=mkljNTcCDK9JHGll__ukGJRE5WzY4quOSzpwi5qHnXvQjrj5eHwb9wxU6jlKedzT7Uh6jvyqyZ-8k-c_R32CgkvVZW9lFEquCj8o5KDNZnQbS0SCT-F_S4kx2PpDA1Ao5q2bZghV50NyHcaWhGYSPO3HZgCOzH2h91HWZgz2s4SU0-8DOvBrzlT12shUz0MR3ER0hCkGbNYnOQzxAfgF6WaEKRD_WQUERfVPiCMPerM%3D)
Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world.
To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine.

| Hi ,
You may have heard, but Gavin Newsom finally agreed to debate me.

But there's a catch...

**Newsom only wants to debate on the radio.

He wants to wait two weeks after ballots have dropped.

He will only debate on a Sunday during prime time for NFL and MLB playoffs.**

Tell me - does that sound like a good plan to present our differences to Californians?

While of course, we will take any opportunity to a live debate, these ‘confines’ around this debate beg the question: What is Newsom afraid of?

[I’m calling on Newsom to debate on live TV, before ballots drop, and not during primetime sports. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=46d081daac&e=f9133ea432)

I believe every Californian deserves the chance to see us debate our differences and show them exactly what we stand for.

This debate should not be for radio listeners only.

**This is for the future of all Californians.**

If you agree, and would like to see Newsom debate me on live tv, let’s send him a message!

Sign your name on this petition below to get **Newsom to agree to a Live TV debate!**

subject: Josh Riley is is a good man, who cares about making the government work for families like yours. He’s running for one of the most strategically important House races in the country. Let me tell you a little bit about him.

| | | | | _Hi, Peter! Cliff again. Did you have a chance to read Al Franken’s message about this crucial House race last week? You probably saw Al in a viral clip recently, explaining to a flustered Republican on CNN that two Supreme Court seats were stolen by Mitch McConnell & Donald Trump, and therefore this Court is illegitimate. _ _This is a hugely important race and your help could make a big difference as we close out the last quarter before the November election. So, as they say in the business Al used to be in, Senator Franken, take it away!......._ __ Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email, I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. And to Blue Amp Action too.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb910699e-b6bd-4fe4-8270-265f5cdda8ad/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some. Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY. After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. Josh is the hardest worker I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend. And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation. **[Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T79bb6169-332c-484d-a3be-ed47b124bfb0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This is important. To me. And to our nation. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: Peter , I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61401414:Juc70fVNS:m:1:3339843426:428B13A91A139C4CD62F7C805471F345:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61401414:Juc70fVNS:m:1:3339843426:428B13A91A139C4CD62F7C805471F345:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61401414:Juc70fVNS:m:1:3339843426:428B13A91A139C4CD62F7C805471F345:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61401414:Juc70fVNS:m:1:3339843426:428B13A91A139C4CD62F7C805471F345:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61401414:Juc70fVNS:m:1:3339843426:428B13A91A139C4CD62F7C805471F345:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61401414:Juc70fVNS:m:1:3339843426:428B13A91A139C4CD62F7C805471F345:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. I just finished an interview on Morning Joe MSNBC, Peter, and I think you'll want to hear what we talked about.
HER Time conducted a poll to find out the extent to which abortion rights are a mobilizing issue for younger women in the US. To get our answer, we surveyed women under 50 in five frontline Congressional districts.
**What we found is a BIG deal. Like a #1, 38-point-net-shift, even-swaying-12%-of-Trump-voters big deal.**
A couple of the highlights are:
💟 Among younger, pro-choice women, 82% said they would cast their votes based solely on a candidate's position on abortions.
💗 Among pro-choice Democrats who are not currently likely to vote, 68% say that the _Dobbs_ decisions makes them more motivated to turn out.
❤️ Among younger Independent and Republican women, there was a net shift of 38% towards a Democrat when compared to an anti-choice Republican.
**Abortion is a WINNING ISSUE. If we can get our frontline candidates the resources they need to reach younger women voters, then we can win a lot of tough races across the country.**

name: Alek Skarlatos for Congress
subject: Is it possible to win your personal endorsement?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alek For Oregon
body:
I'm running out of time to build a winning coalition ahead of the midterms. I need 42 supporters to offer a personal endorsement of my campaign today. | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)
---

Peter,

By now, you probably know my story. But for those of you who don't remember, please allow me to refresh your memory. **It was Friday, August 21, 2015\. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple, and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.**

But someone we didn't expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers.

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn't know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: 'Let's go.'**
**
I've fought like hell to protect the great nation that I call home, both in Europe and in Afghanistan. [Now, I'm fighting like hell to flip a long-held Democrat House seat Republican here at home in Oregon.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r) **

[** ENDORSE ME FOR CONGRESS TODAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836001:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)
But my opponent, well, she's got other plans for me. I nearly lost my life the day I tackled an Islamic terrorist, but in an odd way,**the vicious attacks on my personal character by my opponent are a bit harder for me to swallow.**

**I'm worried that the attacks are having an effect on our polling numbers, despite that none of what she says is true.** That's why we need to be able to show voters here at home how many people are supporting my campaign this year. Which brings me to why I'm writing to you today.**[I am hoping to win your personal endorsement. Your signal of support for my campaign will allow me to make the case to voters here at home that I really am who I say.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)**

[** ENDORSE ME FOR CONGRESS TODAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836001:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)
Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now Democrats are ...
1. Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America.
2. Raising our taxes like we have never seen and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
3. Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology
4. Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)
These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don't care about the people they represent. They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, **Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers.**

I can put a stop to it, but I need you on my team. **[My opponent is spending $40,000+ a week to attack my character in an attempt convince voters that I'm evil.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)** Your endorsement today will go a long way in helping me to convince voters that the lies she is peddling are just that, lies.

[** ENDORSE ME FOR CONGRESS TODAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836001:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)
My life's mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world's bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. **[I am taking that mission and putting it into action by running for Congress, by fighting for my neighbors and their wellbeing in Washington.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)**

This will not be an easy road, which is why I am reaching out to you. I will need the support of every American patriot to win this battle.**[Can I count on you to personally endorse my campaign for Congress immediately?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)**

Thank you,
[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)
Alek Skarlatos
Republican for Congress

**SUPPORT A CONSERVATIVE REPUBLICAN FOR CONGRESS** [** ENDORSE ME FOR CONGRESS TODAY ➞ **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836002:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)

P.S. - I would truly appreciate seeing your name on the growing list of supporters who have personally endorsed me. **[Every single endorsement matters in this race.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)**

| Alek is a former Oregon National Guardsman, completing a nine-month deployment in Afghanistan. Alek, along with four others, stopped an armed terrorist on a Paris-bound train traveling from Amsterdam to Paris in August 2015. His heroism earned him several awards and medals around the world. [**To support Alek's campaign chip in $5 or more today!**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60836000:Wx402PhN2:m:1:2237666910:5002AF7483006FB96EDF992E80ED41E6:r)

Hi , you will have the opportunity to see Dr. Bob virtually tonight.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
Can you please make a contribution to Dr. Bob's campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1] so we can continue to host safe events for everyone across the political spectrum?
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
We are grateful to the Michigan State Police for making strides in the assassination plot investigation. Thanks to the response of law enforcement, we believe that particular threat no longer poses any danger to Dr. Bob's life or anyone else's.
All of our events are open to the public — to anyone regardless of political party — and all will fearlessly move forward as planned.
"There's only one candidate afraid of holding events in the 1st District, and it isn't Dr. Lorinser." - Supporter
Friend,
The 1st Congressional Candidate Forum by the League of Women Voters will go on despite refusal by Jack Bergman, tonight, Tues. Sept. 27 at 7 p.m. It will be broadcasted in the Grand Traverse Area by Traverse Area Community Media on channel 189, and live-streamed on the League of Women Voters [https://www.facebook.com/events/782082699725660] ' Facebook page.
Earlier in the day, team Dr. Bob will be at Bay College in Escanaba this afternoon.
VIEW ALL EVENTS [https://www.votedrbob.com/events]
Also, at the end of this month, we have our last FEC fundraising deadline before Election Day. Here’s what happens with these FEC reports:
Our team will close our fundraising books at 11:59 PM on September 30th and will prepare a public fundraising report that everyone can see. Those numbers will be used to judge just how much momentum is behind Dr. Lorinser.
Right now, absentee ballots start going out to Michigan voters.
Election Day might seem like it’s far away, but voting starts now, as prepare for our last FEC quarterly fundraising deadline before Election Day.
We need to make sure we have the resources to push Dr. Bob over the finish line to victory, and we need your help to get there.
We want to make sure your name shows up in our last FEC quarterly fundraising report before Election Day. Will you stand with Doc and make a contribution before our deadline?
Thank you,
Kevin Numerick

Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. ---

We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. | **ST. LOUIS VOTING OPPORTUNITIES EXPANDED FOR NOV 8 GENERAL ELECTION, OFFERS NO-EXCUSE ABSENTEE VOTING ** ST. LOUIS – Today, the St. Louis City Board of Elections is announcing expanded opportunities for City residents to vote in the upcoming General Election.

On Election Day, November 8, St. Louisans will be able to cast a ballot at their usual polling location or any of 12 Vote Centers across the city. Beginning October 25, Voters can utilize 4 No-Excuse Absentee Centers to cast their ballot in advance of Election Day.

“Voting is the primary way for residents and neighborhoods to express their will. Participation in the process ensures that your voice is heard,” say Ben Borgmeyer and Gary Stoff, Directors at the Election Board.

Through funding from the American Rescue Plan allocated last year, the Election Board has upgraded its voting infrastructure. As a result, voting is more accessible than ever for City voters. On November 8, City voters now have the option of either voting at his or her assigned precinct or stopping by one of the Election Board’s designated 12 Vote Centers to cast their ballot.

In the two-week period prior to Election Day beginning October 25th, voters can now vote a “no-excuse” absentee ballot at any of the Election Board’s designated No Excuse Absentee Polling Places.

To explore voting options, find the closest polling place on Election Day or locate a No Excuse Absentee Polling Place prior to Election Day voters should access the [Polling Places](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=a43f558538&e=a088917f89) page on the Election Board website.

While the Election Board and the City are working together to make voting as accessible as possible, it is important to remember there are new rules regarding photo ID requirements to vote. Accepted photo IDs to vote include a non-expired Missouri driver or nondriver license; a non-expired military ID, including a veteran’s ID card; a non-expired United States passport. Make sure your name on the ID matches your name on the voting rolls. The Missouri Department of Revenue offers residents one free nondriver's license ID through its DMVs. Learn more about how to obtain a nondriver’s license ID as well as documents necessary at [showit2vote.com](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=11faafe297&e=a088917f89) or by calling 573-526-VOTE (8683).

If a voter does NOT have a State of Missouri or Federally issued photo ID, they can still vote at the voter’s polling place by casting a provisional ballot on Election Day. After Election Day, a bipartisan team of election judges will compare the signature on the voter’s provisional ballot envelope to their voter registration signature on file at the Election Board. If the signature matches, the vote will count.

For more information on voting and upcoming elections, visit the [Board of Election Commissioners](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=b05e8b6484&e=a088917f89) webpage or call 314-622-4336.

|
---
| **SENATOR STEVEN ROBERTS APPOINTED TO MISSOURI VETERANS COMMISSION**
JEFFERSON CITY — State Sen. Steven Roberts, D-St. Louis, was appointed to the Missouri Veterans Commission on September 15, 2022 by Minority Floor Leader John Rizzo. Sen. Roberts will fill the vacancy created by Sen. Jill Schupp, who served on the Commission from 2017-2022.

“I am extremely honored and humbled to be given the opportunity to serve Missouri’s veterans”, Roberts said. “Our duty to assist the brave men and women who served in our armed forces is something I do not take lightly. I thank Sen. Rizzo for his faith and trust with appointing me to this role and I am looking forward to contributing to the great work done by this commission.”

Sen. Roberts is a fourth-generation St. Louis native who currently serves as Minority Whip in the Missouri Senate. In addition to his legislative duties, Sen. Roberts is an attorney and Captain with the Missouri Air National Guard. He graduated from the United States Air Force’s Judge Advocate Staff Officer Course (JASOC) and was selected as the Senior Ranking Officer for his JASOC class.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| **SENATE ADVANCES $2 BILLION INCOME TAX CUT TO THE HOUSE**
The Republican-controlled Senate voted 24-4 on Sept. 20 to pass a massive income tax cut that would reduce state revenue by roughly $2 billion a year once fully implemented, according to the legislation’s official fiscal estimate. The bill now advances to the House of Representatives, where a committee is slated to hear it Sept. 28.

Gov. Mike Parson’s special session call authorizes lawmakers to cut the primary individual income tax rate from its current level of 5.3 percent to 4.8 percent, but Senate Bill 3 would drop the tax rate to 4.5 percent. Since the Missouri Constitution prohibits lawmakers from passing legislation outside of the parameters of the governor’s special session call, the bill as it stands right now is unconstitutional.

To put the size of the tax cut in context, the $2 billion in revenue the state would lose each year once the cuts are fully implemented represents about 94 percent of the $2.12 billion in basic state funding appropriated to local public school districts for the current fiscal year.

The income tax rate reductions would be phased in over several years. Wealthier taxpayers would enjoy most of the benefit under SB 3, while lower income Missourians would receive little to nothing in tax relief.

Under the constitution, the special session can last through Nov. 5, but lawmakers are hoping to get it wrapped up by the end of the month so they can focus on their election campaigns in advance of the Nov. 8 general elections.
---
|
---
| **HOUSE AND SENATE TRADE LEGISLATION ON AGRICULTURAL TAX BREAKS**
The Senate and House of Representatives each passed nearly identical bills on Sept. 20 that would provide about $40 million a year in tax breaks to various agricultural producers. However, it isn’t currently clear if either chamber will take up the other’s bill.

The Senate approved its bill on a vote of 26-4. A similar bipartisan vote had been expected in the House until Republican leaders unexpectedly decided prohibit debate, prompting many lawmakers to withhold their support. The House bill ultimately received just one more “yes” vote than the 82 constitutionally required for passage. The final vote on the bill was 83-28, with 20 members voting “present.”

A casualty of the House GOP leaders’ move is that an emergency clause enabling the bill to take effect immediately upon being signed by the governor failed to achieve the required supermajority of 109 votes. Without an emergency clause, the bill, assuming it wins final passage, won’t take effect until 90 days after the special session adjourns.

Although the Senate bill includes an emergency clause, House Republican leaders haven’t referred it to a committee, the necessary next step toward advancing it to debate on the House floor and final passage. Senate leaders likewise have signaled they don’t intend for their chamber to return to take up the House bill. How the stalemate is resolved remains to be determined.

Another issue is the fact that both bills include a number of provisions related to agriculture but that aren’t authorized to be considered by governor’s special session call. Both bill sponsors said they expect the governor to expand the call to cover those added provisions once final legislation is approved, but he hasn’t yet publicly stated his intent to do so.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=bbaa78ca73&e=a088917f89). LOUIS VOTING OPPORTUNITIES EXPANDED FOR NOV 8 GENERAL ELECTION, OFFERS NO-EXCUSE ABSENTEE VOTING ST. LOUIS – Today, the St. Louis City Board of Elections is announcing expanded opportunities for City residents to vote in the upcoming General Election. On Election Day, November 8, St. Louisans will be able to cast a ballot at their usual polling location or any of 12 Vote Centers across the city. Beginning October 25, Voters can utilize 4 No-Excuse Absentee Centers to cast their ballot in advance of Election Day. “Voting is the primary way for residents and neighborhoods to express their will. Participation in the process ensures that your voice is heard,” say Ben Borgmeyer and Gary Stoff, Directors at the Election Board. Through funding from the American Rescue Plan allocated last year, the Election Board has upgraded its voting infrastructure. As a result, voting is more accessible than ever for City voters. On November 8, City voters now have the option of either voting at his or her assigned precinct or stopping by one of the Election Board’s designated 12 Vote Centers to cast their ballot. In the two-week period prior to Election Day beginning October 25th, voters can now vote a “no-excuse” absentee ballot at any of the Election Board’s designated No Excuse Absentee Polling Places. To explore voting options, find the closest polling place on Election Day or locate a No Excuse Absentee Polling Place prior to Election Day voters should access the page on the Election Board website. While the Election Board and the City are working together to make voting as accessible as possible, it is important to remember there are new rules regarding photo ID requirements to vote. Accepted photo IDs to vote include a non-expired Missouri driver or nondriver license; a non-expired military ID, including a veteran’s ID card; a non-expired United States passport. Make sure your name on the ID matches your name on the voting rolls. The Missouri Department of Revenue offers residents one free nondriver's license ID through its DMVs. Learn more about how to obtain a nondriver’s license ID as well as documents necessary at or by calling 573-526-VOTE (8683). If a voter does NOT have a State of Missouri or Federally issued photo ID, they can still vote at the voter’s polling place by casting a provisional ballot on Election Day. After Election Day, a bipartisan team of election judges will compare the signature on the voter’s provisional ballot envelope to their voter registration signature on file at the Election Board. If the signature matches, the vote will count. For more information on voting and upcoming elections, visit the webpage or call 314-622-4336. | | SENATOR STEVEN ROBERTS APPOINTED TO MISSOURI VETERANS COMMISSION JEFFERSON CITY — State Sen. Steven Roberts, D-St. Louis, was appointed to the Missouri Veterans Commission on September 15, 2022 by Minority Floor Leader John Rizzo. Sen. Roberts will fill the vacancy created by Sen. Jill Schupp, who served on the Commission from 2017-2022. “I am extremely honored and humbled to be given the opportunity to serve Missouri’s veterans”, Roberts said. “Our duty to assist the brave men and women who served in our armed forces is something I do not take lightly. I thank Sen. Rizzo for his faith and trust with appointing me to this role and I am looking forward to contributing to the great work done by this commission.” Sen. Roberts is a fourth-generation St. Louis native who currently serves as Minority Whip in the Missouri Senate. In addition to his legislative duties, Sen. Roberts is an attorney and Captain with the Missouri Air National Guard. He graduated from the United States Air Force’s Judge Advocate Staff Officer Course (JASOC) and was selected as the Senior Ranking Officer for his JASOC class. | | | | SENATE ADVANCES $2 BILLION INCOME TAX CUT TO THE HOUSE The Republican-controlled Senate voted 24-4 on Sept. 20 to pass a massive income tax cut that would reduce state revenue by roughly $2 billion a year once fully implemented, according to the legislation’s official fiscal estimate. The bill now advances to the House of Representatives, where a committee is slated to hear it Sept. 28. Gov. Mike Parson’s special session call authorizes lawmakers to cut the primary individual income tax rate from its current level of 5.3 percent to 4.8 percent, but Senate Bill 3 would drop the tax rate to 4.5 percent. Since the Missouri Constitution prohibits lawmakers from passing legislation outside of the parameters of the governor’s special session call, the bill as it stands right now is unconstitutional. To put the size of the tax cut in context, the $2 billion in revenue the state would lose each year once the cuts are fully implemented represents about 94 percent of the $2.12 billion in basic state funding appropriated to local public school districts for the current fiscal year. The income tax rate reductions would be phased in over several years. Wealthier taxpayers would enjoy most of the benefit under SB 3, while lower income Missourians would receive little to nothing in tax relief. Under the constitution, the special session can last through Nov. 5, but lawmakers are hoping to get it wrapped up by the end of the month so they can focus on their election campaigns in advance of the Nov. 8 general elections. | | HOUSE AND SENATE TRADE LEGISLATION ON AGRICULTURAL TAX BREAKS The Senate and House of Representatives each passed nearly identical bills on Sept. 20 that would provide about $40 million a year in tax breaks to various agricultural producers. However, it isn’t currently clear if either chamber will take up the other’s bill. The Senate approved its bill on a vote of 26-4. A similar bipartisan vote had been expected in the House until Republican leaders unexpectedly decided prohibit debate, prompting many lawmakers to withhold their support. The House bill ultimately received just one more “yes” vote than the 82 constitutionally required for passage. The final vote on the bill was 83-28, with 20 members voting “present.” A casualty of the House GOP leaders’ move is that an emergency clause enabling the bill to take effect immediately upon being signed by the governor failed to achieve the required supermajority of 109 votes. Although the Senate bill includes an emergency clause, House Republican leaders haven’t referred it to a committee, the necessary next step toward advancing it to debate on the House floor and final passage. Senate leaders likewise have signaled they don’t intend for their chamber to return to take up the House bill. How the stalemate is resolved remains to be determined. Another issue is the fact that both bills include a number of provisions related to agriculture but that aren’t authorized to be considered by governor’s special session call. | | [Three things have us _really_ worried right now, team:

⚠️ We’re _essentially_ TIED in the polls with Republicans.

Peter, it's Young Kim.

The American Dream is about to collapse.
* Inflation is making Americans poorer
* Government overreach is crushing small businesses
* Record level border crossings are undermining our immigration system
* Our president is dividing our country

It's a disaster.

Unless we change course, our once great nation will hit rock bottom.

I am determined to do everything in my power to make sure that never happens, and I'll stand tall for the American Dream, even if I'm the last Republican standing in Deep Blue California.
But as hard-pressed as I am to protect the American Dream, I can't do it alone.

With only **3 WEEKS** until mail-in-ballots go out, we are running out of time to lockdown my vulnerable seat from turning over to a Far Left Democrat.

That's why I'm humbly asking for your help: without a foundation of committed grassroots supporters, we'll be overrun by my opponent's Left wing smears and my seat will flip back to Blue.

Will you join my team today and help me win in the biggest midterm election of our lives?

body:
Pollsters worry that we’re in for a repeat of 2016’s polling disaster

|
---
Derek, Remember that awful feeling you had on that morning in November 2016? The pollsters had all said for months that Hillary Clinton was certain to win the presidency. Well, _Politico_ thinks pollsters might be at risk for another surprise this November. | | **I want to tell you about why Congressional Republicans are targeting this seat and why I'm going to ask for you to take action –[with a grassroots contribution as we get closer to the November election. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51437145/369345981/-821065315?refcode=2022-09-27-eoq3&recurring=0&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a854a436-833e-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhODU0YTQzNi04MzNlLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rUClGmmFD3bEezfcT1ZxLblQENixQ3X9tuUku8-QP4U=)** But let's take a step back first. Four years ago, going into the midterm elections with Donald Trump as President, I know we felt a tremendous urgency. We needed to do _everything_ in our power to turn things around here in America after so much had gone wrong. **And we did. We out-organized Republicans and won a House majority. Then we won the White House and took back the Senate.** The margins are thin, and the work has been very hard. name: Paul Begala
subject: I know what a tough race looks like
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dan Kildee
body:
| After decades in politics and countless Democratic campaigns, I know a tough race when I see one. _And Dan Kildee is facing a VERY tough race in the midterms._

His final quarterly FEC reporting deadline before the election is at the end of the month and he has to make his numbers public. | | Hi Peter, We never thought we’d say this, but we agree with Lindsey Graham. In a television appearance this weekend, Graham said that Republican politicians “owe it to the American people” to share their stance on abortion. Meanwhile, out-of-touch millionaire Mehmet Oz continues to hide his stance on the GOP’s national abortion ban. **While Oz refuses to be forthcoming with Pennsylvania voters, we think it’s pretty obvious what his position is. He’s said point blank that he believes that “abortion is murder.”** So why won’t he be honest about his position on the federal ban? Because he knows how widely supported abortion is, and knows taking such a position will cost him votes. **That’s pretty embarrassing, Oz. ** So which will it be? A millionaire who’s such a coward that he won’t even take an actual position? Or pro-choice John Fetterman who doesn’t mince words when it comes to his distaste for a national abortion ban. What was Fetterman’s response to the proposed national abortion ban? Hell no!

## Reschedule Appreciation Cookout
---
|
---
Due to my recent move, I will need to reschedule our appreciation cookout. We underestimated how long it would take us to move and get resettled into our new place. We will be rescheduling for November after the election.
I have had hundreds of emails, texts, calls, and personal encounters with supporters who are worried that I will not be running in 2024, don't worry, I think you will be very happy. I'm not going anywhere, I'm here for the fight!
In other news, our church is planning our yearly Christmas outreach. Every year we surprise a lower-income area on Christmas eve we go door to door giving gifts to kids.
It's an absolutely amazing feeling to see the looks on the kid's faces and the tears in the parent's eyes. Last year I believe we did over 100 doors.
This year we are planning a pop-up block party in a housing project. The families don't know we are coming with bikes, presents, a DJ, haircuts, hot chocolate, Santa, hotdogs, and more. If you or your organization would like to participate please let me know. We are taking tax-deductible cash and monetary donations now. You can give them at the links below.

Now, we’re counting on you to step up. Ahead of Friday’s deadline, will you chip in $7 to join the 32,120 Democrats in Pennsylvania who’ve donated to fight back against the GOP, elect Democrats nationwide, and continue building a better America? We need 24 more supporters from Manassas. As the sole party organization tasked with electing Democrats from the school board to the Senate, the DNC has built historic programs so our candidates have the resources they need to compete and win everywhere possible. But with only a few days until the DNC’s critical fundraising deadline, I’m counting on you to step up. As a grassroots-powered organization, the DNC relies on people like you chipping in what you can, when you can. 98% of all gifts to the DNC this year were $200 or under -- that means that our work is made possible in large part by folks like you, and your gift today will be a direct investment in the grassroots, voter protection, and on-the-ground organizing efforts that will help Democrats win in November and beyond. # Christmas Outreach
---
|
