# **South Bay CRA News**
Our church is planning our yearly Christmas outreach. Every year we surprise a lower-income area on Christmas eve we go door to door giving gifts to kids.
It's an absolutely amazing feeling to see the looks on the kid's faces and the tears in the parent's eyes. Last year I believe we did over 100 doors.
This year we are planning a pop-up block party in a housing project. The families don't know we are coming with bikes, presents, a DJ, haircuts, hot chocolate, Santa, hotdogs, and more.
If you or your organization would like to participate please let me know. We are taking tax-deductible cash and monetary donations now. You can give them at the links below.
Give to the Christmas outreach:
Paypal: www.paypal.me/derrickgates
Cashapp: $derrickgatesmin
Venmo: @Derrick-Gates-4
Blessed and Free
**Nena Gates**
President
nenarenae2@gmail.com

body:
The dominos are about to fall
Peter, I've read the polls. I've done the math. And I've poured over the latest FEC reports.
**I don't know how else to say this... I'm shocked and disappointed because Republicans may lose the House.**
First, I emailed you when nine Republicans were DOWNGRADED in key races -- _nothing!_
Then, Fox News said Democrats could keep their Liberal Majority in the House AND Senate -- _still nothing!_
Now, I'm emailing you AGAIN because we're about to miss our LAST End-of-Quarter deadline of the midterms --_it keeps getting worse!_
**Time is almost up, so I 'm pleading with you one last time before the deadline.** I need to know if you have what it takes to dig deep and help us meet our most important goal of the entire year. Even just $25 can help make the dominos fall in our favor. Walk away now, and we risk a COMPLETE DEMOCRAT TAKEOVER!
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421737:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)
**[CHIP IN $25 TO WIN THE HOUSE >>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421738:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)**
**[CHIP IN $50 TO WIN THE HOUSE >>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421739:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)**
**[CHIP IN $100 TO WIN THE HOUSE >>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421740:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)**
[**Here 's why contributing TODAY is so much more important than what you might give next week or next month: voters in key swing states like North Carolina, Minnesota, and Virginia are already casting their ballots, your dollar could be put to use as soon as TODAY.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421737:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)
A donation made today gives us the best opportunity to target voters who are on the fence or need an extra push to go vote. We need your help to make sure we have emergency reinforcements to organize our field teams, fund our final ad campaigns, and fuel our get-out-the-vote efforts in battleground districts.
**[CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT TO WIN THE HOUSE >>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421737:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)**
Through thick and thin I've always been optimistic about our chances, but I've never been scared of losing like this before.
[**Please, I 'm counting on you stepping up today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421737:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r) The future of our movement depends on what you do next.
Thanks,
Steve Scalise
* * *
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421741:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61421741:6rqY8MV8N:m:1:3253819041:FA59163B16C318A18AC4C5D7E7C1B109:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

| | | Friend, it's Tim Scott. I only have a minute so I'm going to get straight to the point.

I grew up in a single-parent household and almost failed out of high school. If it weren't for my supportive mother and mentors, who knows where I would be today.

The American Dream - the possibility of going from cotton to Congress - was never guaranteed to me. Now, I'm committed to making sure that every child has the same opportunities regardless of which side of the tracks they grew up on.

But listen, Friend, winning this fight is impossible without your support.

Friend, it would be an honor if you continued to support me - can you spare $10 to help me continue my fight in the Senate?

Tim Scott

name: American Briefing
subject: Your invitation: National Survey on Socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z51uo7br8i75sbdckn2gve1cvlikuh685fup5058_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg68o30c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uprb0ojm6hoe8sb5c1onastnmdhr4s72mti7echl66o6fctichg7bd1i62p72o77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6sqrcdtmc5j38ppjchjr1db5e8iv0)
| | This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsb5cg2kcahe65o9k260lemkn4k14l1l4l9g3dag_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg68o30c3h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z24rd60aek8q7kei54jhk2quug4icg8ta7lmpe6g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg68o30c3h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbev64pcplpq95uln4d0ohvqp3aioc5s9ka7u5ro_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg68o30c3h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Vernon
subject: Let's build on Trumps Black vote for the midterms
body:
| Peter \-- I told you I wouldn't send you 8 emails a day and insult your intelligence with ridiculous appeals. I promised you I would not send sky is falling emails. Here is the situation. We have radio ads running in 16 media markets in Georgia to help elect Herschel Walker to the Senate and Chris West to the House, in Ohio to elect J.D. Vance to the Senate and J.R. Majewski to the House and in North Carolina to elect Ted Budd to the Senate and Smith, Castelli and Harrigan to the House. We only have money for one more week. Fundraising is way down because direct mail fundraising is high correlated with consumer confidence. Brandon has run the economy into the ground. No Confidence = no fund raising. That is why this email is so important. Your donation of can keep us on the air. So I want you to use this donation button to buy more ads. Please click on it even if you haven't made up your mind so you can listen to one of the ads running now in Georgia. | [](blackamericansmaga.org/donate "Donate today") [Donate today](blackamericansmaga.org/donate)
---
Not Convinced yet?
President Trump got 22% of the black male vote and the highest overall black vote since Nixon in 1960.
Twenty seven percent (27%) of black respondents in a poll earlier this year said they plan to vote for the Republicans in the midterms.
Half of black males in Los Angeles refused to vote for the black Democrat female candidate for mayor. If democrats are bleeding that badly in liberal Los Angeles what will happen in more conservative swing states?
But only Amazon can sell something without asking for the sale. Everyone including conservative candidates have to ask for the order, or in this case, the vote.
The GOP and its candidates have not followed Trump's lead on getting black votes. They continue to ignore urban contemporary radio, a medium black voters know and trust.
In 2014, my ads aimed at black voters 35+ moved those voters 11% in eight weeks and won a Senate race for Thom Tillis.
We can do that again in Ohio, Georgia and North Carolina but only if you donate money for more radio ads today.
[](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=radio&n=1 "Donate Today") [Donate Today](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=radio&n=1)
---
Thank you for doing the hard work of freedom.
Vernon Robinson
PS. Even if our ads are the only ones running, they drive the Left off message, lower turnout and help conservative candidates in a close race kick a field goal. Please give what you can today.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfqifn7lgpsgus8ve9abqvifp79f1eepfob5vsi0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65slkmuoe9dbgeqondd5lc3jrcc5nc9onfc72c6qn8s32e4oe8d3h6mr7ad5hckrjfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32dplmorrcob661rj6or7m2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm6ob6c1i6co33c8iv0)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zuik1fn4710uc9v92jhulr198ks75n8dgk9s26vo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg68pj0cdh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

I served as a Green Beret in the U.S. Army because I was willing to go to any length to defend our country from its enemies.

_I may no longer wear my military uniform, but that doesn’t mean I’ve stopped fighting for America._

**Now I’m running for Congress because we need leaders who can protect our country from threats domestic and abroad. Congress needs a revival of members who believe in American strength, and we can bring it.**

**Our HUGE end-of-quarter deadline is just days away, and I need YOUR help, Fellow American. If we’re going to clean up Congress, we need to do some _major_ fundraising to get there first.**

[**Please stand with me so we can take our Army-strong values to Congress.**](http://links.patharriganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d400fe4f8ca24360a0914af7db39ca7b&_m=2970ce2caed44e76a675d673dad2d4bc&_e=TdVMeOckf9Z0-5tbrXXZbM8t8_lV-QZdANhvTAnTfW9mb5I7d8Rjjcfp5HWe9p7eseSfeSIHpGlUMmkO2dnCHSqVrAxAPsm8VKKYXsQDJVUS0sbPUsPyS5G5Yk2wZe7B_R0ez5TNZfeHXfYLBPJNKzS5ZAgFHDJhpTtjiUsruINJ4yEK9RlPfedY2P1legKgGg87z_exNejwNtMvt8-XCruXQrV3-tpZtxQl2kh6Cew5_35a2NbkJnglaxh003u5_nOwFdwcxhmWKszSBDuNDyhDZJ0ij_NRUqO_jekN-hO1InLvOKNk4OsrCAbO40iLmJWna4I_-dwX8bAW8Q1Skk7vZxb8AqSTul7KOO4010Xr2Dxbzl_1UythtdbWjl0p)

In the Army, millions of lives depended on the actions of me and my team. Doing my job well wasn’t an option, it was duty.

Similarly, millions of Americans depend on Congress to make laws that keep them safe and protect our country. Our congressmen have duties, but lately those duties have been forgotten and abandoned.

That will all end when the people elect a NEW era of Conservative leaders this November. With your support, we will make Congress work for the people again.

Subject: Karamo's anti-choice beliefs (extreme)
To: Our friend
Friend,

We know that Trump-endorsed Kristina Karamo represents a clear threat to democracy. But her extremist opposition to reproductive rights makes her dangerous to the liberties of Michiganders.

Not only does Karamo believe in an outright abortion ban, including cases of rape and incest, she has called the medical procedure “satanic” and equivalent to “child sacrifice.” And at her nominating convention, she said fighting against abortion rights was the reason why she got into politics in the first place.

Clearly she’s missing the fact that the office of secretary of state does not have the power to decide abortion policy. But imagine an official with such pathological and extremist anti-choice opinions serving statewide in Michigan? If taking away a woman’s right to choose was the sole reason Karamo ran for secretary of state, you can guarantee this focus would distract her from performing the essential duties of the office.
At best, this could mean the failure to process drivers licenses in a timely manner or the return of chaotic wait times at offices.
At worst, she could use her statewide position of power to push her extremist positions on the state and interfere with the counting of votes to advance her fringe ideological beliefs.
If her anti-democratic rhetoric is any indication, Karamo would attempt to bend the powers of the office to advocate against abortion rights in Michigan.
This November, Michiganders will have a choice. They can support Jocelyn Benson, a proven leader who is focused on the right things, like slashing wait times to 20 minutes or less and who believes in free and fair elections for all, OR they can support an election denier who is obsessed with eliminating a woman’s right to choose forever.

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Former rival endorses Erik Aadland
body:
We all want a better future
| | | |
---
---
|
# Tim Reichert Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from businessman, economist and former candidate for Colorado's 7th Congressional District, Tim Reichert.
Dr. Tim Reichert is president and CEO of Denver-based Economics Partners and former candidate for Congressional District 7. Reichert brings nearly 20 years of experience in applied economic consulting, and has practiced in a wide range of areas, including transfer pricing, complex valuation, lost profits and lost benefits (economic damages) analysis, and intangible asset pricing and valuation.
Prior to founding Economics Partners, Reichert was a Managing Director and the global service line leader for transfer pricing and economics at Duff & Phelps, LLC.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Reichert said:
"It is my pleasure to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress. I am very happy that the people of Congressional District 7 have the opportunity to be represented by a man of such accomplishment and character. As an economist, I believe Erik has a solid grasp of the 'kitchen table issues' facing our community, as well as the best policy interventions that can be made to remedy those issues. I want Erik's future constituents to know that they are being served by someone who knows the cost of freedom and the opportunities that are meant to come with it. Their interests will be well served with Erik as their representative in Washington."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am honored by Tim's endorsement, which comes from a man of strong convictions, great moral character, and a deep abiding commitment to his faith. His work-ethic, policy acumen, great intelligence and compassion for people elevated the primary battle and pushed me to be a better candidate with a greater understanding of the issues and my constituents. I hope to draw on his economic expertise as I work in Congress to alleviate inflation and the destruction of opportunities caused by failed Democrat policies. I am deeply grateful to have Tim's support and confidence."
---
---
| |
---
---

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York, or shady philanthropists backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

---
| |

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

body:
What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people?
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7e0v1kem4bhuc0m98421d6nvnelji7q53qgc7d8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbob6c36mdq69dtgm6orcspjc4qnacpk6uqj3cj4mhq36c37cdj3cp3im9qmbc5nmv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664rjbdhnmpjmccdimdhmfc5lclp2bs)

---
| | Friend, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztl61v49sb533k7u0ll115qd5h51nr39v31mrnqg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That’s because**I’M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It’s time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zo1obher878he2r654f8mcvpmhfept3aigi26e4g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zo0rvito11hmona87uqibtbcdmnvpmst8ocvabi8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I’m the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhah06grcdsnbvq87sttu5d97oa0viff7p05gg1g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)
---
Together, we’re going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there’s a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I’ve always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that’s not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z32r80a593md7gvor4ksaue4pqrd8k3puod34ivo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had — that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that “BDE” that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress — which is my favorite compliment of all — that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsa9nbm3u0hjdoetrbqab22oe34pu2f5d06k7fj0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Friend, let’s not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country.** ** It’s our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay.** ** And it’s our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track.** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona!** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It’s game time.** ** And I need you on my side.** ** **_[Will you support our momentum?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5voj8cbel97bo6pka1h6f1gt2fghlo818a98108_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)___**
---
Now, I don’t care if you’re with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America. ](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z13crehi3go1fm0aptm51703en5e3be2o74eptu0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zee6moqi0evvekn6vn09af8g1cor5ol22hc1nui8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpg6epb6cdh2bs)
---
Sincerely,

If you ask my family, friends and team about me, one thing you’ll probably hear pretty quickly is that I’m a straight shooter.
#

If you ask my family, friends and team about me, one thing you’ll probably hear pretty quickly is that I’m a straight shooter. After years on the bench as a judge and the former Chief Justice of North Carolina, it’s just my nature.
That mindset is what I think you deserve from your next U.S. Senator, and it’s how we’ve tried to run this campaign.
From the start of this campaign, we’ve tried to be as transparent as possible because there would be no campaign without the support of folks like you. That’s why we don’t do the fake “triple matches” or scare tactics you probably see elsewhere.
I want you to know that when we ask it’s because it’s important. It’s because I know that $3 and $10 at a time will make a difference.
And with our official FEC deadline in 3 days, the reality is that we need to ask for a lot of help this week. We’ve got our most ambitious goal ever, and the honest truth is we are significantly behind on our fundraising.
So I am humbly asking you today:
[**Can you please make a donation of $3 or whatever you can afford to our campaign today? We have to reach this goal to ensure we have the resources to fend off the dark money flooding our state.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220927-1-MA&t=1&akid=1855%2E357359%2EN6zo37)

I truly believe our job is to use every dollar you give as effectively and efficiently as possible. And there are still important investments we can make today that will pay massive dividends when the votes are counted.
But with just weeks to go and the FEC deadline in 3 days, there is no time to waste.
[**So please, if you can, donate $3 to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat. Anything you can spare today gets put to work immediately to help us organize in all 100 counties and get our message in front of more voters.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220927-1-MA&t=26&akid=1855%2E357359%2EN6zo37)

body:
...and here in Texas, no less!

| | | |

**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
Saturday, a large group of us showed up to First "Christian" Church in Katy, TX to protest "Drag Queen Bingo," a supposed kid-friendly event.

It's no longer _just_ schools that are attempting to _sexualize_ and _groom_ **our kids**... now this **evil LGBTQ+ agenda** has made it's way into the "church."

And yes, it's happening right here in the Greater Houston Area.

I had the privilege of being invited to speak at the **Rally Against Child Grooming** protest, and I provided 3 practical action steps we all _**MUST**_ take in order to Preserve America and pass on our Judeo-Christian values to the next generation.

**We must resolve to:**
* _**Prioritize**_ liberty _over_ leisure.
* _**Get involved**_ and serve.
* _**Inspire others**_ to do the same.

**I share my thoughts in the video below.**

Due to only having a few minutes to speak, I didn't get to go as deep as I'd have liked... but if you'd like me to send you the notes I jotted down while preparing my speech to get the full story, reply back to this email and I'll shoot them over in a PDF.

This election boils down to two questions: Whose side do you stand on?

MAGA Republican Laurel Lee was hand-picked by Governor Ron DeSantis to run for this district. Laurel sided with the Supreme Court when they overturned Roe v. Wade, calling it the "correct decision." And Laurel stands with the NRA and the gun lobby, vowing to never vote for gun-safety reform.

Alan Cohn believes women's rights are human rights – he'll vote to codify Roe v. Wade into law. He stands with families who are sick and tired of the horrific gun violence that has plagued Florida and our nation – he'll take on the NRA and the gun lobby. That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjt6a1okticuu6uha72171dn24da9ickib9nm19g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpi68oj0cdh2bs)**

subject: Senate Update: America Is on the Move
body:
| | | [Click here to open this e-mail in its own browser window](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet//view_newsletter_setup.aspx?link=SenVanHollen%2501161953%2501NEWSLETTER%2b09-27-22%2b2pm%250115577.38588209.5907953.7517223%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Friend%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Silver%2bSpring%252c%2bMD%2b20906%2501Friend%2501) | [Click here to open a plain text version of this email](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet//view_newsletter_setup.aspx?plain_text=Y&link=SenVanHollen%2501161953%2501NEWSLETTER%2b09-27-22%2b2pm%250115577.38588209.5907953.7517223%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Friend%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Silver%2bSpring%252c%2bMD%2b20906%2501Friend%2501)
---|---
| | | **September 27, 2022** |
---|---|---|---
| | |
### Building a Stronger Future
Just last month, we took historic action to address some of the biggest challenges our nation faces through the [passage of the Inflation Reduction Act.](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-inflation-reduction-act-marks-transformative-progress-on-climate-change-prescription-drug-costs-and-corporate-tax-reform-&redir_log=213584054321305) This landmark bill addresses the worsening climate crisis, sky-high prescription drug costs, a tax code that unfairly puts corporations and the wealthy before working Americans, and inflation - all while reducing our national debt and creating new jobs. [The Inflation Reduction Act is now law](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1559947065656053762&redir_log=595114756065374), and it's here to improve the everyday lives of Marylanders - from lowering their health care costs to creating good-paying clean energy jobs. Over the last few weeks, it has been great to join Marylanders across our state to [celebrate](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1557837989417558016&redir_log=137974616156375) what this legislation does for Maryland and our country. In addition to working closely with colleagues to pass this bill through the Senate, I authored two key provisions that were included in the final law. One - based on my HOPE for HOMES Act - will help lower home energy costs for Americans while creating jobs and tackling the ongoing climate crisis. I was recently joined by Maryland homeowners, workers, healthy housing and climate advocates, and federal, state, and local officials in Baltimore to [highlight](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-hosts-rally-with-mfume-mayor-scott-president-ferguson-maryland-workers-homeowners-and-advocates-to-highlight-inflation-reduction-act-provisions-to-lower-energy-costs-create-jobs-and-combat-climate-change&redir_log=301438599661880) that provision, which will provide consumers with large rebates to help them pay the upfront costs of making their homes more energy efficient. Those home improvements are projected to save homeowners up to $750 every year on their energy bills. On top of that, the HOPE for HOMES provision in the Inflation Reduction Act includes $200 million for job training in the energy efficiency sector, and that investment alone is projected to create 50,000 jobs over the next few years. In total, this measure is a win-win-win: it will save homeowners money, generate more good-paying jobs, and help confront the climate crisis by reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The other provision I authored creates a Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund, which will provide resources that can be used to launch a National Climate Bank to partner with the private sector and community-based lenders to make an array of investments in clean energy technologies and energy efficiency improvements. This will serve as a force multiplier for the development and deployment of clean energy on a national, regional, and local scale. Additionally, 40 percent of the general funding in the provision will be used for targeted investments to underserved communities that have been overburdened by pollution. The Inflation Reduction Act also includes over $60 billion in tax credits to boost clean technology manufacturing. These tax credits are going to incentivize green energy companies to do business in the U.S., build their factories in the U.S., and employ American workers - investments that are critical for the continued economic success of our state and our country. Right now, two clean energy companies are building wind turbine fabrication centers in Maryland to support their offshore wind farms coming to the mid-Atlantic - and together, these projects will create a minimum of 10,000 jobs over the next several years. By making the U.S. even more attractive for other green energy companies through the new tax credits in the Inflation Reduction Act, we'll be able to spur additional economic growth in our state and across the country - all while fighting the existential threat of climate change. In short, the transformative Inflation Reduction Act will address a number of critical challenges facing our nation, including our fight against the climate emergency, our battle to lower the costs of prescription drugs, health care, and other important needs, and our efforts to build an economy that invests in more prosperity and opportunity for all Americans.
---
### Standing Up to Big Money Special Interests
Following the infamous 5-4 decision in the Supreme Court case _Citizens United_ , big-money special interest groups started pouring dark money into our elections in an effort to completely reshape our democracy. That's why I authored the DISCLOSE Act during my time in the House of Representatives - and why for years, Senator Sheldon Whitehouse and I have been [sounding the alarm](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1572294147645804550&redir_log=788041541066373) about the urgent need to pass it so we can shine a light on this secret political spending in elections. Last week, the Senate took that legislation up for a vote, and I urged Republicans to finally join us in standing up to special interests and giving voters the right to know who is spending gobs of money to influence their votes. In recent years, some Republicans have expressed concern about the power of dark money, and this was a chance for them to prove whether they really want dark money out of our politics - or whether this is just more hypocrisy. Instead of standing with us to make our democracy stronger, Republicans blocked our legislation with the anti-democratic filibuster, effectively giving the go-ahead for big special interest groups to [keep dumping billions in dark money into our politics](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1572998425024643072&redir_log=778677828344373). But even though the Senate GOP blocked our bill, the fight goes on. I will never stop working to put the voices of the American people before big money special interests. But I need your help to get that done. Democracy isn't a spectator sport. Our success as a nation depends upon an informed citizenry ready and willing to tackle the most pressing challenges of our day.
### Bringing Manufacturing Back to America
Over the summer, the Senate took up the [CHIPS and Science Act,](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-provisions-pass-senate-in-bipartisan-bill-to-enhance-american-competitiveness-in-technology-innovation&redir_log=345662358851178) bipartisan legislation to boost American leadership in innovation and technology. This bill invests in American semiconductor manufacturing, research and development, and emerging technologies - and will, over time, lower costs for Americans, create good-paying jobs domestically, strengthen our country's national and economic security, improve our supply chains, and sharpen our competitive edge in the global economy. When it comes to technology, standing still means falling behind - and this bipartisan bill will help bolster American innovation and help ensure we remain the world leader in cutting-edge technologies - from artificial intelligence to quantum computing.

I fought hard to pass this bill - and have spoken repeatedly on the importance of making this investment in our nation, [from the bill's introduction last year](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-sasse-announce-inclusion-of-their-bipartisan-proposal-to-curb-ip-theft-in-banking-amendment-to-china-competition-bill&redir_log=890042450541270) to the [floor debate](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2fwatch%3fv%3dqa9AuTR0qbY%26feature%3dyoutu.be&redir_log=18479309088445) on this legislation only a few weeks ago. I also authored several measures within the final package that passed Congress, including one to establish a mechanism to ensure the United States develops a [national strategy](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-blunt-introduce-bipartisan-legislation-to-strengthen-the-united-states-global-competitive-edge&redir_log=637340696221118) to invest in the key technologies of the future - and another to ensure we put all of our brainpower to work by expanding research capacity at [Maryland HBCUs and peer institutions](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-tillis-introduce-bipartisan-legislation-to-spur-greater-research-and-investment-in-local-hbcus&redir_log=762530766041114) across the country. On top of that, the CHIPS and Science Act authorizes a doubling of the overall budget of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), which has its headquarters in Gaithersburg - and that new authorization also marks a tripling of funding for the manufacturing public-private partnerships program at NIST. These investments will help supercharge American development and discovery and support the work of Marylanders on the front lines of cutting-edge federal research.

This new law marks an important step forward for American technological leadership on the global stage and will help keep our economy strong. After that bill became law, I joined federal and local leaders in Frederick to discuss how we can seize this moment in our history to ensure Maryland is at the global center of high-tech manufacturing - and I am confident that the CHIPS and Science Act will help us move that mission forward.
### Honoring Our Promise to America's Veterans
We've got to keep our promises to veterans who put themselves at risk to serve our country, and that includes ensuring they have access to high-quality health care. That's why we took action to pass the bipartisan [PACT Act](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fmaryland-delegation-members-applaud-presidents-signing-of-veterans-health-care-bill-with-funding-for-two-maryland-veterans-clinics&redir_log=008720900731290), which provides health care benefits for all generations of toxic-exposed veterans for the first time in our nation's history and will improve access to care for all those who served in our nation's armed forces. This legislation also provides $75 million for the VA to expand and upgrade its network of veteran outpatient clinics in Maryland, including $43 million to support the construction of a new Baltimore Community Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) and $32 million for the construction of a new Prince George's CBOC.

Taken together, all of the elements in this legislation mark a huge win for our communities and a critical step forward in improving access to quality health care for veterans across our state. I fought to send this bill to the President's desk alongside key Senate colleagues - and this historic bill is now the [law of the land](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1557434903708532737&redir_log=119633271373374).
### Partnering With Community Leaders
The Senate has made major progress over the past few months in addressing the challenges our communities face every day. But those victories wouldn't have been possible without the tireless work of advocates and leaders from across our state who have been demanding change - and working closely with me and my colleagues in our nation's capital to make that change happen.

Over the last few weeks, I've met with Maryland seniors, health care champions, climate leaders, and so many others to discuss the important work we've been doing in the Senate. I've joined Marylanders across our communities to celebrate what the Inflation Reduction Act does for our state and our country - from [faith leaders](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1567502218332356609&redir_log=515059936148373) in Baltimore to [nonprofit advocates](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1567614263207804929&redir_log=082210214689374) on the front lines of building out a modern 21st century workforce. On top of that, I recently joined an AARP Maryland Town Hall to discuss how this law will be a [game-changer for our seniors](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.facebook.com%2fchrisvanhollen%2fposts%2fpfbid02kFEA5qyUZV25ERHombWLFprq4BKWkVCKj2m3AXGygz8h6CbxKeZC4EXiN6radTs6l&redir_log=234977541678784).

When we were fighting to pass the PACT Act, I spoke with [veterans outside the Capitol](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1554611450492108800&redir_log=7324777895372) to thank them for all they've done - and voice my support for this landmark legislation. And in August, I spoke with leaders from the [Maryland Association of Counties](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1560358180860870657&redir_log=250584500689374) about how Maryland will benefit from the historic Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the Inflation Reduction Act, and other federal initiatives. While I was on the Eastern Shore, I had the honor of joining [Maryland's National Aquarium](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1560300399021760512&redir_log=489597168967372) to release two sea turtles - named Cello and Bassoon - back into the wild, and I look forward to continuing my work with the National Aquarium family to get the Sea Turtle Rescue Assistance Act across the finish line to create a permanent federal grant program to support organizations responding to and caring for threatened and endangered sea turtles.

These experiences have affirmed my steadfast belief that we are stronger together - working shoulder-to-shoulder in order to deliver for our communities. It's in that spirit that [I hope you will continue to stay engaged.](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15577.38588209.5907953.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fcontact&redir_log=475918421268285)

clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | | September 27, 2022 | ---|---|---|--- | | | Building a Stronger Future Just last month, we took historic action to address some of the biggest challenges our nation faces through the This landmark bill addresses the worsening climate crisis, sky-high prescription drug costs, a tax code that unfairly puts corporations and the wealthy before working Americans, and inflation - all while reducing our national debt and creating new jobs. , and it's here to improve the everyday lives of Marylanders - from lowering their health care costs to creating good-paying clean energy jobs. Over the last few weeks, it has been great to join Marylanders across our state to what this legislation does for Maryland and our country. In addition to working closely with colleagues to pass this bill through the Senate, I authored two key provisions that were included in the final law. One - based on my HOPE for HOMES Act - will help lower home energy costs for Americans while creating jobs and tackling the ongoing climate crisis. I was recently joined by Maryland homeowners, workers, healthy housing and climate advocates, and federal, state, and local officials in Baltimore to that provision, which will provide consumers with large rebates to help them pay the upfront costs of making their homes more energy efficient. Those home improvements are projected to save homeowners up to $750 every year on their energy bills. On top of that, the HOPE for HOMES provision in the Inflation Reduction Act includes $200 million for job training in the energy efficiency sector, and that investment alone is projected to create 50,000 jobs over the next few years. In total, this measure is a win-win-win: it will save homeowners money, generate more good-paying jobs, and help confront the climate crisis by reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The other provision I authored creates a Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund, which will provide resources that can be used to launch a National Climate Bank to partner with the private sector and community-based lenders to make an array of investments in clean energy technologies and energy efficiency improvements. This will serve as a force multiplier for the development and deployment of clean energy on a national, regional, and local scale. Additionally, 40 percent of the general funding in the provision will be used for targeted investments to underserved communities that have been overburdened by pollution. The Inflation Reduction Act also includes over $60 billion in tax credits to boost clean technology manufacturing. These tax credits are going to incentivize green energy companies to do business in the U.S., build their factories in the U.S., and employ American workers - investments that are critical for the continued economic success of our state and our country. Right now, two clean energy companies are building wind turbine fabrication centers in Maryland to support their offshore wind farms coming to the mid-Atlantic - and together, these projects will create a minimum of 10,000 jobs over the next several years. By making the U.S. even more attractive for other green energy companies through the new tax credits in the Inflation Reduction Act, we'll be able to spur additional economic growth in our state and across the country - all while fighting the existential threat of climate change. In short, the transformative Inflation Reduction Act will address a number of critical challenges facing our nation, including our fight against the climate emergency, our battle to lower the costs of prescription drugs, health care, and other important needs, and our efforts to build an economy that invests in more prosperity and opportunity for all Americans. Standing Up to Big Money Special Interests Following the infamous 5-4 decision in the Supreme Court case Citizens United , big-money special interest groups started pouring dark money into our elections in an effort to completely reshape our democracy. That's why I authored the DISCLOSE Act during my time in the House of Representatives - and why for years, Senator Sheldon Whitehouse and I have been about the urgent need to pass it so we can shine a light on this secret political spending in elections. Last week, the Senate took that legislation up for a vote, and I urged Republicans to finally join us in standing up to special interests and giving voters the right to know who is spending gobs of money to influence their votes. In recent years, some Republicans have expressed concern about the power of dark money, and this was a chance for them to prove whether they really want dark money out of our politics - or whether this is just more hypocrisy. Instead of standing with us to make our democracy stronger, Republicans blocked our legislation with the anti-democratic filibuster, effectively giving the go-ahead for big special interest groups to . But even though the Senate GOP blocked our bill, the fight goes on. I will never stop working to put the voices of the American people before big money special interests. But I need your help to get that done. Democracy isn't a spectator sport. Our success as a nation depends upon an informed citizenry ready and willing to tackle the most pressing challenges of our day. Bringing Manufacturing Back to America Over the summer, the Senate took up the bipartisan legislation to boost American leadership in innovation and technology. This bill invests in American semiconductor manufacturing, research and development, and emerging technologies - and will, over time, lower costs for Americans, create good-paying jobs domestically, strengthen our country's national and economic security, improve our supply chains, and sharpen our competitive edge in the global economy. When it comes to technology, standing still means falling behind - and this bipartisan bill will help bolster American innovation and help ensure we remain the world leader in cutting-edge technologies - from artificial intelligence to quantum computing. I fought hard to pass this bill - and have spoken repeatedly on the importance of making this investment in our nation, to the on this legislation only a few weeks ago. I also authored several measures within the final package that passed Congress, including one to establish a mechanism to ensure the United States develops a to invest in the key technologies of the future - and another to ensure we put all of our brainpower to work by expanding research capacity at across the country. On top of that, the CHIPS and Science Act authorizes a doubling of the overall budget of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), which has its headquarters in Gaithersburg - and that new authorization also marks a tripling of funding for the manufacturing public-private partnerships program at NIST. These investments will help supercharge American development and discovery and support the work of Marylanders on the front lines of cutting-edge federal research. This new law marks an important step forward for American technological leadership on the global stage and will help keep our economy strong. After that bill became law, I joined federal and local leaders in Frederick to discuss how we can seize this moment in our history to ensure Maryland is at the global center of high-tech manufacturing - and I am confident that the CHIPS and Science Act will help us move that mission forward. Honoring Our Promise to America's Veterans We've got to keep our promises to veterans who put themselves at risk to serve our country, and that includes ensuring they have access to high-quality health care. That's why we took action to pass the bipartisan , which provides health care benefits for all generations of toxic-exposed veterans for the first time in our nation's history and will improve access to care for all those who served in our nation's armed forces. This legislation also provides $75 million for the VA to expand and upgrade its network of veteran outpatient clinics in Maryland, including $43 million to support the construction of a new Baltimore Community Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) and $32 million for the construction of a new Prince George's CBOC. Taken together, all of the elements in this legislation mark a huge win for our communities and a critical step forward in improving access to quality health care for veterans across our state. I fought to send this bill to the President's desk alongside key Senate colleagues - and this historic bill is now the . Partnering With Community Leaders The Senate has made major progress over the past few months in addressing the challenges our communities face every day. But those victories wouldn't have been possible without the tireless work of advocates and leaders from across our state who have been demanding change - and working closely with me and my colleagues in our nation's capital to make that change happen. Over the last few weeks, I've met with Maryland seniors, health care champions, climate leaders, and so many others to discuss the important work we've been doing in the Senate. I've joined Marylanders across our communities to celebrate what the Inflation Reduction Act does for our state and our country - from in Baltimore to on the front lines of building out a modern 21st century workforce. On top of that, I recently joined an AARP Maryland Town Hall to discuss how this law will be a . When we were fighting to pass the PACT Act, I spoke with to thank them for all they've done - and voice my support for this landmark legislation. And in August, I spoke with leaders from the about how Maryland will benefit from the historic Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the Inflation Reduction Act, and other federal initiatives. While I was on the Eastern Shore, I had the honor of joining to release two sea turtles - named Cello and Bassoon - back into the wild, and I look forward to continuing my work with the National Aquarium family to get the Sea Turtle Rescue Assistance Act across the finish line to create a permanent federal grant program to support organizations responding to and caring for threatened and endangered sea turtles. These experiences have affirmed my steadfast belief that we are stronger together - working shoulder-to-shoulder in order to deliver for our communities. | Friend
Hurricane Ian is on its way to Florida, and whether you've experienced severe weather before or this is your first time with a major hurricane, I wanted to share a few updates on how to get ready if you're in Florida or if you're keeping tabs on the hurricane outside the Sunshine State.
1. Always stay up-to-date with local or national weather reports. Subscribing to your local television and radio stations' alerts and email lists will provide you with the latest information. The Florida Division of Emergency Management also provide these services and are updating their social media pages every few minutes with new guidance and information. Visit [floridadisaster.org](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001apGhyELUPhM-wztW_kZipbNGwI9xjvyAMQOPjBh37C9GeWO7BO-L01WTZ3G0YXVz2dbmMt7QufJZWdvZPecAdLJH9wjKFKcc5yAr8Ch-N3oKVLaSO-xmt1q8g3P8B-bEG_6JZt8ojKFhqm5JyLhc9Q==&c=xkdCI8oDeV8uBMLRJqveoNQ0RfnLRtwIHvUWLep9Z__4BgJHtP4T6A==&ch=TIgSB511UnMZq2SFS8igDQP1c-wc5kWZKcyDx0wYzB1ACWB_OG10_g==) to sign up.
2\. Sign up for alerts from your local authorities. I encourage folks in Florida to sign up for their local county or city emergency text alerts and to keep the 24/7 citizen information line phone numbers handy before and after the storm. Our counties in Florida's Third have published useful information about sandbag fill-up stations, emergency shelters, and school closures.
3\. Build an emergency supplies kit. As folks make final runs to the store, make sure you have at least 72 hours' worth of emergency supplies, including bottled water, canned foods, necessary medications, extra batteries, and more. Visit [floridadisaster.org](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001apGhyELUPhM-wztW_kZipbNGwI9xjvyAMQOPjBh37C9GeWO7BO-L01WTZ3G0YXVz2dbmMt7QufJZWdvZPecAdLJH9wjKFKcc5yAr8Ch-N3oKVLaSO-xmt1q8g3P8B-bEG_6JZt8ojKFhqm5JyLhc9Q==&c=xkdCI8oDeV8uBMLRJqveoNQ0RfnLRtwIHvUWLep9Z__4BgJHtP4T6A==&ch=TIgSB511UnMZq2SFS8igDQP1c-wc5kWZKcyDx0wYzB1ACWB_OG10_g==) for a useful checklist.
4\. Prepare your home for possible storm surges, flooding, or severe wind. The storm will deliver heavy rains and wind to our region. Secure loose items in your yard, cut down vulnerable trees near homes or vehicles, and take photos of your property before the storm in the event of damage that must be repaired.

Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423494:JQ5QYMVwN:m:1:3331421248:72294952396A747CC1D57E01C7918339:r "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423494:JQ5QYMVwN:m:1:3331421248:72294952396A747CC1D57E01C7918339:r "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hours of this quarter's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423494:JQ5QYMVwN:m:1:3331421248:72294952396A747CC1D57E01C7918339:r "So what do you think? Will you be
a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

To do this, we must be able to buy ad time, send mailers, and build up a strong voter turnout operation. We’ve now entered the home stretch of this election. Early voting has already started, and we have a little more than a month until election day. We don’t have much time left. We must act quickly. We need your help. As the son of hardworking farmworkers, I was up against all odds to become a United States Congressman.

My family lived in a small trailer in rural California. My brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table.

Eventually, with the help of my family and my community, I went to UCLA and eventually to Harvard Medical School.

I can’t imagine where I would be without my community behind me. That’s the reason I have dedicated my life to service. First as a doctor and now as a Congressman representing Coachella Valley.

_But the GOP is working overtime to unseat me._

Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423401:6i-FYMVNE:m:1:3253819041:756957FF1009BB0628C5CC9AD0B04689:r "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423401:6i-FYMVNE:m:1:3253819041:756957FF1009BB0628C5CC9AD0B04689:r "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hours of this quarter's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423401:6i-FYMVNE:m:1:3253819041:756957FF1009BB0628C5CC9AD0B04689:r "So what do you think? Will you be
a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423402:6i-FYMVNE:m:1:3253819041:756957FF1009BB0628C5CC9AD0B04689:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

body:
Canvassing and other unique opportunities are coming up. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c4b0f8b25274/lets-flip-a-state-delegate-seat-15043953?e=db24e76724)

| | |
# Friends,
Early voting starts in less than 30 days, so I need as much of your support as I can get to bring us across the finish line and finally give Hagerstown some real representation in the House of Delegates!

I wanted to share some upcoming opportunities to get involved this week.

Can't make it? Your monetary support is highly appreciated (and very much useful) as well, even if it's just a couple bucks! ([https://donorbox.org/grossman-for-hagerstown](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=078e70fc6e&e=db24e76724))

**Tuesday, 9/27 - Canvassing with Brooke at 4pm (Meeting at the WCDCC HQ)**
[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=60c7561b6b&e=db24e76724)
Come out and help me knock doors! We will meet at WCDCC HQ (140 W Washington St) and supplies will be distributed there.

**Wednesday, 9/28 - Canvassing with Brooke at 4pm (Meeting at the WCDCC HQ)**
[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=0f834910a4&e=db24e76724)
Another day, more streets to hit! Once again, we will meet at WCDCC HQ (140 W Washington St) and supplies will be distributed there.

**Thursday, 9/29 - Campaign Ad Filming at 4pm (Meeting at the Mural of Unusual Size)**
[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=c6f85f265e&e=db24e76724)
This is a super unique opportunity to get involved! We're going to be filming an ad and we need some extras and as well as supporters to tell us why you support us. We will be starting at 4pm on the Cultural Trail next to the Mural of Unusual Size (On W Baltimore Street between Summit Ave and S Potomac St- you can't miss it!).

**Saturday and Sunday, 10/1 and 10/2 - Weekly Canvassing at 1pm alongside the campaigns of Shawn Perry and David Trone (Meeting Locations TBD)**
Join us for our weekly united campaign front! Locations will be decided soon. If you're interested, email my campaign director at [brettguess01@gmail.com](mailto:brettguess01@gmail.com) to make sure you get all the details when they're available.

\--

Information on getting involved via phonebanking will also be coming soon, so keep an eye out! Thank you for all of your support so far!

See you on the campaign trail,

Brooke Grossman
[brooke@grossmanforhagerstown.com](mailto:brooke@grossmanforhagerstown.com)

subject: Did you give up?
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412014:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)

Peter,

You likely receive 10+ emails a day from politicians asking for money, promising to solve all your problems, and telling you the sky is falling...

_This is NOT one of those emails_.

I'm sending you a personal follow up about my message for the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)... **I haven 't heard back from you and I'm worried you're either ignoring me or worse, you're giving up on our fight for liberty. **

This is one of the last times I'll try reaching you about this.

I connected with Zilvinas Silenas (he lets me call him "Z" for short), the President of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE), and made him a BIG promise.

**Before I tell you what I promised Z, let me tell you _his story about growing up under the Soviet Union and how he 's fighting for liberty_:**

Z was born in Lithuania and lived under the rule of the evil Soviet Union.

He grew up in poverty, without rights to free speech or economic liberties, and remembers listening to state-sponsored radio. His family knew the media was simply a propaganda machine for the Communist regime.

He has since moved to the United States and dedicated his life's work to fighting for liberty, free market capitalism, and defeating socialism.

I'm proud to call Z my friend and support the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

FEE is educating both high school and college students about the true principles of free markets, entrepreneurship, individual liberties, and personal responsibility. Their flagship program, "FEE In the Classroom" is teaching students these important lessons and values in order to save our Republic from socialism.

**Here is the promise I gave Z: **

[_**I promised to help raise $25,000 from my personal supporters for FEE 's mission to educate high school students about liberty and free markets. Please click here to donate $1,000, $500, $100, $50, $25, or any amount you can send today.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412014:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)

When I gave Z my word he nearly fainted and dropped his phone in shock.

You see, this is personal for him.

Can you imagine growing up under the rule of the Soviet Union? Z has personally witnessed the destruction of socialism and has vowed to defeat it in the United States.

I believe he can.

But he needs your help.

The Foundation for Economic Education has served as America's top free-market educator. In fact, President Ronald Reagan read FEE's materials and some of the greatest economists in our country's history have worked for FEE:**Milton Friedman, F.A. Hayek, Ludwig Von Mises and more. **

Here's an ugly truth for you, Peter... Politicians will not save us.

Trust me, I see them at work every day.

The reality is, we must change the culture and educate the next generation about the principles of liberty and free enterprise. That's why I am asking you to donate to the Foundation for Economic Education:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412015:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412018:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412019:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412020:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412021:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412022:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>> **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412014:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)

This is personal for my wife Kelli and I as well.

Watching our kids grow up, it was always my desire to pass on my love for America, my passion for liberty, and belief in free markets to my children.

You and I must invest in the next generation of young leaders and teach them about the values and ideas we care so deeply about.

Can I count on you? Will you reply to this email by making a donation?

I told Z I would help FEE raise $25,000 in the next 72 hours._He is counting on me to fulfill that promise_.

Which is why I am asking my top online supporters to make a donation.

[_**Please click here to donate $1,000, $500, $100, $50, $25 or any amount.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61412014:JpNhuMVXN:m:1:3334294963:BA03DA448D351A208D1F89DF184C6567:r)

Your support means a lot to both Z and myself.

Let's build the next generation of pro-liberty leaders and spread our message of limited government, free enterprise, and economic liberty.

Thank you,

Rand Paul, M.D., U.S. Senator

subject: Explaining what’s at stake:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Texans for John Lira
body:
I know you’re getting a lot of emails. But I need to explain what’s at stake before our final FEC quarterly deadline before the election.

I’m a veteran. I’m a public servant. And, I am a candidate running for Congress. But I’m also a dad.

I feel a responsibility to my daughter and four nieces — and every kid out there — to leave them a country that’s better than I found it.

For me, that means:

— Stopping the NRA from paying politicians to vote down real gun safety legislation.
— Passing laws to expand services for our veterans and military families.
— Ousting Republicans who want to control reproductive rights.

Please believe me when I say: There has never been more on the line than in this election. I’m fighting for my family and yours, but I can’t do it alone — not when Tony Gonzales has nearly $2 million to use against me. We’ve set a goal to raise $5,000 before Friday at midnight to ensure we can hit our goal and make this the best filing yet. Can I count on you to donate $3 or more now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lirafecfinal?refcode=EM_FR_2220927EOQ3_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=3]

I’ll be honest: I don’t like asking you for money. But here’s why I have to do it.

Republicans are inches from taking back the House majority in Washington — and they’ll keep sacrificing our children's futures and our families if we can’t stop them.

Hi Peter, it's Joy's campaign manager Brigette.

I hope you saw the new poll that dropped yesterday (see below). It's the second poll this month showing Joy in a statistical tie with Kevin Stitt!

The race is extremely tight -- and it's clear that Stitt is scrambling to respond. **Peter, our plan is working and Stitt knows it.** [**Help us keep up this momentum for Joy by chipping in any amount you can afford right now. >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51444320/369370917/296341931?refcode=em22_220927_EOQ2_scrambling&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjU2NmNiMi05MTNlLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcHB66G60yQZtcQ1GZnnxdYl0FMjpGqCYdbeAIXQr0g=)

Just this morning Stitt called a press conference to push for an idea that Oklahoma Democrats have been suggesting for a decade: cutting the grocery tax. But Stitt can't even lead the members of his party to support it.

And now, Stitt is refusing to join Joy for a public Q&A session with college students later this week. Joy is looking forward to telling people about her vision for Oklahoma, but Stitt is going to be a no-show.

After years of chaos and ineffective leadership, this is more of the same.

[**We have a strategy to win -- but we need your help to get it done. So I'm asking if you can pitch in today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51444321/369370925/296341931?refcode=em22_220927_EOQ2_scrambling&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjU2NmNiMi05MTNlLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mcHB66G60yQZtcQ1GZnnxdYl0FMjpGqCYdbeAIXQr0g=)
