body:
| |
---
| | | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423537:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "It kills me to say this")
---
Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423537:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423537:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hours of this quarter's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423537:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "So what do you think? Will you be
a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423538:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423538:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423540:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking
for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423540:65MTlMVRN:m:1:3317145305:9A5C4DADABCB59E52A5B4E7A8913561F:r "Step up now!")**_

subject: Exposing Zuckerberg’s Election Plot
body:
Enough is enough. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-9428399?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

**They thought they got away with it. ** Mark Zuckerberg orchestrated an elaborate, illegal plot using dark money to sway the 2020 presidential election and has suffered no consequences.

The scheme involved hundreds of millions of dollars, a former Obama campaign manager, and a network of tax-deductible nonprofits. The goal? Inject more than $400 million into the 2020 election in order to "throw it" to President Biden and write it all off as a tax deduction in the process.

Now, we’re shining a light on what really happened and holding them accountable. After months of _careful research and legal examination_ , we recently submitted legal complaints with the IRS against Mark Zuckerberg, his wife, and three voting rights groups for **election meddling**.

This past week we went on a media blitz to draw attention to our IRS complaints and Zuckerberg's disgraceful efforts to help Biden win.
---
|
---
| **Exposed: Zuckerberg’s Shady Election Plot Against Trump**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=33ea0642d3&e=17913c7d6d)
---

In the lead up to the 2020 election, Mark Zuckerberg and his wife Priscilla Chan made $500 million in tax deductible donations to nonprofits. These donations were managed by former Obama campaign manager David Plouffe. He ensured this money was funneled through nonprofit, tax-exempt voting rights groups in a taxpayer subsidized effort to sway the 2020 election against Donald Trump.

Read a portion of our statement which was [cited in a report](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=16df129e56&e=17913c7d6d) on Fox News:

_"It is beyond disgraceful to imagine federal taxpayers subsidizing the partisan preferences of billionaires who easily could have given to a Democrat super PAC in 2020. But, of course, then they would not have been able to take a tax deduction, so they disguised the political nature of their donations and shuffled them through 'charitable' intermediaries, making ordinary Americans foot the bill."_

**We can’t let them get away with this.** That’s why we’ve filed complaints with the IRS against Zuckerberg, Chan, and the non-profits that received the donations.
|
---
| **Watch: CRA Joins Fox News to Discuss IRS Complaint Against Zuckerberg**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=71880ab60b&e=17913c7d6d)
---

In addition to the writeup in Fox News, I made [an appearance on Fox Business with Maria Bartiromo](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=7c424e32df&e=17913c7d6d) to discuss our IRS complaint.

In [one part](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=f150a324f1&e=17913c7d6d) of our discussion, I told Maria that the money from these nonprofits was given to “privatized local election offices, so the same people running the election had an interest in Democrats winning.” I followed up with “That's not allowed. If that is legal, then nothing is illegal.”

_The IRS must investigate this issue_.
|
---
| **Media Roundup: Alerting America First Patriots**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5837ca5f8d&e=17913c7d6d)
---

The complaints have been filed and action has been taken. Now we’re on a media blitz so we can alert as many America First patriots as possible about this plot.

I’ve made appearances on [War Room with Steve Bannon](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=a0c85b3051&e=17913c7d6d), [The Charlie Kirk Show](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=15d8c1645e&e=17913c7d6d), [The Laura Ingraham Show Podcast](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0ca5ba5223&e=17913c7d6d), and [The Great America Show with Lou Dobbs](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=f836a5f4a1&e=17913c7d6d).

Our actions have been written about in conservative publications like [The Federalist](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=7ac03732e2&e=17913c7d6d), and even international news outlets like [The Daily Mail](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3121eb2a74&e=17913c7d6d).

We’re not stopping anytime soon. We need to get the word out and do everything within our power to _**stop this from ever happening again**_.
| **We’re Not Stopping: How You Can Join the Fight**
---
| We will expose Zuckerberg’s dark money plot to sway the election and ensure this is investigated. Our commitment to fighting back is why we have President Trump’s support. We don’t just write briefs and conduct policy panels. _**We go toe-to-toe with the enemy**_.

[Take a stand! Support our fight against Mark Zuckerberg and his shady plot to sway elections! ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=a15e53acc3&e=17913c7d6d)

This entire ordeal shows exactly how the radical left operates and what the America First movement MUST fight back against. It’s why we must band together and do everything we can to fight back.

As always, thank you for your generous support. Together we can back our country and stop the radical left from illegally influencing elections.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

body:
You have my word that as Missouri's next senator, I will work night and day to ensure that every family has access to high-quality, affordable healthcare.
| | |
---
Peter, when one of my sons was only 6 years old, he was attacked by a dog and got a terrible bite near his eye.
To this day, it remains one of the most nerve-wracking experiences of my life. **We were seriously concerned that my son might lose his eye entirely.** And to make matters more complex, we were out of town at the time and away from all of the doctors we would normally see.
I can still recall the chill that ran through my spine as we frantically took him to the nearest hospital. It didn't matter that I was a nurse – and that I'd seen plenty of injuries and wounds. **I still felt the same helplessness and fear that overtakes any mother when her child is in danger.**
On that day, I counted us as incredibly lucky to have found a hospital with doctors who could save his eye. **But when I think about that day now, I also recognize just how lucky we were to be able to focus so exclusively on our son's health and not about whether doctors or hospitals were in-network or whether our insurance would accept the claims.**
During my years as a nurse and again now on the campaign trail, I have heard so many stories about people rationing their insulin, mothers sitting in ER parking lots with their kids as they wait in case they deteriorate any further, and people not being able to afford the prescription drugs they need.
**There is simply no reason why this should happen.**
People should be able to focus exclusively on their well-being and the well-being of their loved ones – not haggling with their insurance companies and making sure they can afford both the care that they need and their mortgage or their next grocery bill.
Fixing this problem starts with electing leaders who will fight for real solutions and lift up the voices of families back home. **You have my word that as Missouri's next senator, I will work night and day to ensure that every family has access to high-quality, affordable healthcare – and I will get it done. [But to win the change families are counting on, I need you to stand with me: Please, will you make a donation before my end-of-quarter deadline to help me flip this seat blue and get to Washington so that I can bring a nurse's heart to the Senate and finally fix our broken healthcare system?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51490639/369426337/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk322-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjQwODdkMC1iODNlLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w1vSE25uDUo3JdNW0szwv5tou-9zZEKAIpRTjLOGSJ0=)**

It would be bad for not just Southwest Oregon, but for the country if I lost on November 8th. Becuase I think people have had enough of this one party leadership that's obviously taken us down the wrong path. It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier. But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever. Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers. And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist. But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington. Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream. Right now, Democrats are... Opening and destroying our borders. Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable. The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House THIS November. My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. immediate attention. And action.

Trump’s right-wing MAGA minority in the House needs to flip just 6
Democratic seats to take the majority.

DOZENS of House Democrats are being outspent by far-right MAGA Republicans
RIGHT NOW in races we CANNOT afford to lose just 6 weeks before Election
Day.

I don’t need to remind you that 147 Republicans in Congress voted to
overturn the 2020 election. Or that they will attempt to enact a
nationwide abortion ban and end Social Security, Medicare, even our
democracy as we know it if they take our majority.

Your response RIGHT NOW, before our FINAL FEC quarterly fundraising
deadline of the midterm this week, will make a huge difference in helping
our Democrats close the spending gap.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_pelosi.2Okbo6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC_20220927_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=972%2E5257348%2E1Ao5m1 ]Derek, Democrats have never needed your support more than
right now. Can you rush in $10 immediately so we can WIN these midterms
and defeat anti-choice, anti-democratic Republicans?

This isn’t a normal midterm election. And a normal response to this email
won’t suffice.

Republican operatives are looking at the public FEC fundraising reports
Adam and I are filing THIS WEEK to see whether grassroots Democrats like
you are fired up.

If we post the same run-of-the-mill numbers, McConnell and McCarthy will
call up their top donors and special interests to spend OBSCENE amounts of
money to defeat our Democrats in these final weeks. We can’t let that
happen.

So, I’m asking you (yes, you, Derek!) to step up in this
crucial moment.

The ONLY way we can overcome the flood of Republican money into our
Democratic districts is by marshaling enough resources to DEFEAT every
Republican running to flip our Blue majority so we can EXPAND our
Majorities in the House and Senate to ensure this is the CLOSEST Trump’s

thousands of others who stood up in this historic moment to beat the odds

body:

His track record on women’s rights, voting rights and *following the law* isn’t great. **And voters across Texas are taking notice: Recent polling shows Rochelle Garza down just THREE POINTS among likely voters. #
Peter,
With less than 7 weeks to go until the election, every day counts toward our efforts to:
1. **Organize to turn out the vote** to re-elect Pramila and Democrats over extremist Republicans here in Washington.
2. **Support progressives all around the country** who will join our caucus and fight for the bold, lifesaving policies we need.
3. **Campaign against the GOP’s hateful agenda** and stop them from taking control of Congress.

As you may well know, all of this work requires resources that take time to build up. **Our campaign needs to raise $30,000 by midnight Friday to hit our ambitious goal of $350,000 for the financial quarter.** For a few weeks, we hit a fundraising slump that had us worried, but thanks to the overwhelming support of our grassroots base, we’ve pulled through.
**$30,000 may sound intimidating, but with tens of thousands of supporters behind Pramila, we know it’s possible.** Pramila fights for us every single day in Congress and on the campaign trail. Now we’re asking you to support her. [**Will you stand with Pramila at this critical time and donate right now?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17749?refcode=em20220927-1658&t=1&akid=1658%2E420207%2EIu1NAn)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17749?refcode=em20220927-1658&t=20&akid=1658%2E420207%2EIu1NAn)**
If we reach our goal and raise $30,000 more by 11:59pm Friday, we’ll be in a very good position going into the final few weeks before the election. **The good news is, we’re catching up – but we can’t afford to get complacent now.**
Many Republicans have stockpiled considerable amounts of money, amassed over time thanks to the corporate PACs and 1% mega-donors who line their campaign’s pockets. **That’s what we’re up against.**
We have to be able to compete with the GOP’s resources if we want to hold our Democratic majority, turn out the vote, and elect as many progressives as possible. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message 📧
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423546:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423547:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423547:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423547:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423548:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423549:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking
for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61423549:JMsiEMV6N:m:1:3317145305:286BAE0EC9C2DB959F7E0F0B360F281F:r "Step up now!")**_

Roger Marshall’s resolution that would terminate the Covid emergency declaration. Sen. The American people are fatigued and yearning to operate outside of the confines of supersized government; they long for their God-given freedoms, and for leaders to take their side. In March the U.S. Senate voted for my Resolution to repeal this emergency declaration and delivered a symbolic victory that limited government and our constitutional rights still reign supreme. It’s high time for Joe Biden and his Administration to stop using COVID to implement their partisan political agenda and focus on the surge in crime and the fentanyl epidemic that is wreaking havoc across this nation and killing Americans at record rates._

body:
From single mom to hopeful Congresswoman, I know in my heart that anything is possible. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=26f29f726ad048c9b04f570cae3a9b42&_e=f6dKV0h9J6cLZYqOsIukUHIx8erbAbT_yO40Moy2erbw4G37KUvQMq1v-DUL4-77w24xeux8vKf7RTewCRpb_5aw1Of49mzNMVDrpivS__qF_k9RwE0hmrX6GKd9JeSFvJyk0-CfYIkp5SMixN3l5RMMDowFyIB3PiqG0QxuExkG8aISYCxt04a2UZy8BeHl-5CaryZhD-kwQlnAKHvmCHNCLHLQNLGjauajN7fiKkbYT7AfohN31OOJnsKaEWRPMjdjPiAwmWdh6RVR2o3uhwbqNIIORLROHyMZC15pZnbS4DXusCHsxRj6OizUuFI_N9avGKLd-p31X4yBD8lRcgAYIOpkkXCYfJgaFZ2zr2BICQjiigM4C4jtJx7IqL3tdx_vMjE24pY8JhFBh3_JH4lvkp4UZfQH6zPlpYw73RA%3D)

Friend,

Unlike most of these professional politicians, I didn’t have a privileged leg up or a family member that could make some introductions for me to get to where I am today.

So let me introduce myself – **[my name is April Becker and I’m running for Congress.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=26f29f726ad048c9b04f570cae3a9b42&_e=f6dKV0h9J6cLZYqOsIukUHIx8erbAbT_yO40Moy2erbw4G37KUvQMq1v-DUL4-77w24xeux8vKf7RTewCRpb_5aw1Of49mzNMVDrpivS__qF_k9RwE0hmrX6GKd9JeSFvJyk0-CfYIkp5SMixN3l5RMMDowFyIB3PiqG0QxuExkG8aISYCxt04a2UZy8BeHl-5CaryZhD-kwQlnAKHvmCHNCLHLQNLGjauajN7fiKkbYT7AfohN31OOJnsKaEWRPMjdjPiAwmWdh6RVR2o3uh4cuAXeIUw9gcG2G-vc8z6snaLIEeUcOM5Dy_fPJ2Jl_4i785n9CJcpxGRCAHRFq-U0cylS05vA0EIuvcaSheDECp_Y7eD9-cirTJDxOL8g4K-irKETEhAYcws-8UPUo2F7tNvSHBhtltaMR5RVVp8g%3D)**

**I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could.**

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=26f29f726ad048c9b04f570cae3a9b42&_e=f6dKV0h9J6cLZYqOsIukUHIx8erbAbT_yO40Moy2erbw4G37KUvQMq1v-DUL4-77w24xeux8vKf7RTewCRpb_5aw1Of49mzNMVDrpivS__qF_k9RwE0hmrX6GKd9JeSFvJyk0-CfYIkp5SMixN3l5RMMDowFyIB3PiqG0QxuExkG8aISYCxt04a2UZy8BeHl-5CaryZhD-kwQlnAKHvmCHNCLHLQNLGjauajN7fiKkbYT7AfohN31OOJnsKaEWRPMjdjPiAwmWdh6RVR2o3uh43oLiIByVzFmJPbySEx5EI9ngwOlRuKb1RjvDDGCQMFWlvGCnMrc2elh6dpwuiryd2jrc8TUvo-mlSp6BpSX7eYAAQzNbTk3lgVcYgZ6eame5qaVxrzaC9l3qonTUgQ5M0FmHk4o_TlkkMNwPq1BbQ%3D)
At age 39, I graduated law school. I won’t lie and paint some idealistic picture; **it was a struggle to get there, but it was all so worth it.** The type of experience you gain in life by pulling yourself up by your bootstraps is something that can’t be bought or taught at the country club.

That’s what this campaign is about. It’s about representing the average American. It’s about the mom with three kids trying to balance a full-time job and soccer practice. It’s about the blue-collar worker saving for their child’s college fund.

**It’s about you – and that’s why[I need your help.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=26f29f726ad048c9b04f570cae3a9b42&_e=f6dKV0h9J6cLZYqOsIukUHIx8erbAbT_yO40Moy2erbw4G37KUvQMq1v-DUL4-77w24xeux8vKf7RTewCRpb_5aw1Of49mzNMVDrpivS__qF_k9RwE0hmrX6GKd9JeSFvJyk0-CfYIkp5SMixN3l5RMMDowFyIB3PiqG0QxuExkG8aISYCxt04a2UZy8BeHl-5CaryZhD-kwQlnAKHvmCHNCLHLQNLGjauajN7fiKkbYT7AfohN31OOJnsKaEWRPMjdjPiAwmWdh6RVR2o3uhxootWQWIsrYrjrO-Wvm2ySF2LypToWTzqgKcSL1Wf1HCvN-l_dFMc40r-3mysEctZDdHX9xMRgKdNaFPjE9s5xefYnCu3WdKy7mtmiTpJU12jtaGxrN8_VcJiFw-Im1Xd0Y4pq0r1fmpH3YmyG0NzI%3D)**

body:
As a working mother who pulled herself up from her bootstraps, achieved the American Dream, and is now in the final weeks of a Congressional campaign, | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f4f06a8afd864a5d85d91ac5f33ff3e5&_e=MyVcDOOSiEK9BF3da0yXACf3C99CIGeQLVxFa_9hkw0aXhxZQzjM3yGCfiNaQLtluQ-7mzlN98E8bybGNgAjvt7WcaOAojUiWGPo2cPZW2-LfNaUcgsfj90A5PkNMQzWRt6Le0IN_yVNIc4ryMeWbboGKqhMiNnZlpjQu5G20ouywzMDEqAiPkvC9x8RVflfYy0VDvAcznIuRl5aXGJTdVhJFBosE0o_Vxo5sqd7AbojRKHzXWdwl4CNPEtJlppjD_i7X2s6oWQeNwBdik-wh84m7Ft2UlRGdGDtUbE5w9b_MC6AVm4CESnOaSJfqCD3dTU7LwdGrYWIXrZPK8d9u7k1KKZ-i_yRW2VWGGYvgR05L6GGJV2Z_CfIYda1yl1npptG-6t0THelGzCeWA2yFGWRDaqZk5RqVPQQxF1_LC8%3D)
---
Peter,

Unlike most of these professional politicians, I didn’t have a privileged leg up or a family member that could make some introductions for me to get to where I am today.

So let me introduce myself – **[my name is April Becker and I’m running for Congress.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f4f06a8afd864a5d85d91ac5f33ff3e5&_e=MyVcDOOSiEK9BF3da0yXACf3C99CIGeQLVxFa_9hkw0aXhxZQzjM3yGCfiNaQLtluQ-7mzlN98E8bybGNgAjvt7WcaOAojUiWGPo2cPZW2-LfNaUcgsfj90A5PkNMQzWRt6Le0IN_yVNIc4ryMeWbboGKqhMiNnZlpjQu5G20ouywzMDEqAiPkvC9x8RVflfYy0VDvAcznIuRl5aXGJTdVhJFBosE0o_Vxo5sqd7AbojRKHzXWdwl4CNPEtJlppjD_i7X2s6oWQeNwBdik-wh1m8cNi00OU07AxM6-kDpwy4zSSbsN3TU9dlF0e5Bm9IpFgGp2yZLSrYbB0XEopZ1sGE1KC_FmuVnf9TTczPZiYyi9EXdHb4aBeTu1swUQk7ZIovHC7-5-rKQjrdKAVZ9XZJu6X92JpgUs6wBU9a7HU%3D)**

**I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could.**

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f4f06a8afd864a5d85d91ac5f33ff3e5&_e=MyVcDOOSiEK9BF3da0yXACf3C99CIGeQLVxFa_9hkw0aXhxZQzjM3yGCfiNaQLtluQ-7mzlN98E8bybGNgAjvt7WcaOAojUiWGPo2cPZW2-LfNaUcgsfj90A5PkNMQzWRt6Le0IN_yVNIc4ryMeWbboGKqhMiNnZlpjQu5G20ouywzMDEqAiPkvC9x8RVflfYy0VDvAcznIuRl5aXGJTdVhJFBosE0o_Vxo5sqd7AbojRKHzXWdwl4CNPEtJlppjD_i7X2s6oWQeNwBdik-wh-Am8Z5QC2H2pB-aG-xqShOQnkxq1BFBXm-canLRVAPSt2lUo71M8HmgZi2BveVSF8Kfp247WfsqmUz0JpRdhkpVY8nQey_bt_I09Jz_LW1PaIAjLuDtWC9GHaECsaaqtozAimS45FQ7mnG0aMLW-ws%3D)
At age 39, I graduated law school. I won’t lie and paint some idealistic picture; **it was a struggle to get there, but it was all so worth it.** The type of experience you gain in life by pulling yourself up by your bootstraps is something that can’t be bought or taught at the country club.

| Hi — I know it’s late, but I wanted to reach out to give you a quick update.

At midnight on Friday, we’ll close the books on our September fundraising and our opponent, along with his backers, will be able to measure the strength of our grassroots campaign going into the final weeks of the race. body:

Hello Peter Reed Olson did it – **he helped save the library!** Reed turned on the pressure to secure a 3-2 victory. The preliminary budget includes full funding for the library, thanks to his advocacy and leadership in our community.**Of all the issues facing us, why does this one matter?
** When you think about what makes a community a community, many ideas probably come to mind. Reed fought fiercely for a piece of the budget to fund the library because it is so much more than a building with books. **It’s a centerpiece of civic engagement.** It is where we share cultural heritage, where we give a voice to the voiceless, and give everyone an opportunity for empowerment through resources they can use to improve their situations. Saving a library means saving one of the last places we have to experience community without paying to be there. **Reed is fighting for OUR community, OUR Northwoods values, and OUR issues.** Critical issues like:
* Affordable housing
* Mental health resources
* More daycare openings

**Help us keep the momentum going.
** We need you and your friends to knock on doors – no experience required! You’ll get all the training you need before you go. Just bring your passion, enthusiasm, and a smile. **Next Steps:**

body:
One colleague in Congress said they were “shocked” to see how hostile her own party was towards Alexandria from the moment she arrived — and she still faces hostility to this day.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220927-3434-header&t=1&akid=3434%2E2526796%2ErK0Oxf)
Alexandria’s community sent her to Congress on purpose to disrupt and challenge a lot of what’s wrong in D.C.
But during her first term, many people in her own party said her election was a fluke, a mistake, and that there was “nothing to worry about.” Many believed that Alexandria would be a one-term Congresswoman.
One colleague in Congress said they were “shocked” to see how hostile her own party was towards Alexandria from the moment she arrived — and she still faces hostility to this day.
It was clear from the beginning that the party never wanted Alexandria there. It’s why a Moderate Democrat mounted a $3 million primary challenge and why Republicans spent over $10 million trying to unseat her in 2020.
**But now Alexandria is facing off with a MAGA Republican opponent in the general election this November.** They’ve already set up a massive #OustAOC sign in Queens, so we need to be ready to fight back against their posters, mailers, commercials, and whatever else they’ll throw at us in these last 6 weeks.
[Can we count on your first $3 contribution today to help us fight back against their disinformation about our Congresswoman with deep organizing and truth telling?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220927-mu.rp23wl&refcode=em20220927-3434-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3434%2E2526796%2ErK0Oxf)

Team AOC

Justice Democrats

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Team,
It’s not often we take anything we see on Twitter too seriously. But we did come across a tweet the other day that we wanted to share with you:
“The devil works hard, but Slotkin hustles harder!”
It’s true, if we do say so ourselves. Since Michigan’s new district lines were announced, Elissa has been on the ground across the new 7th constantly. Getting to know voters, building relationships with new local leaders, and asking small business owners what they need to succeed.
The folks here on Team Slotkin have been pretty busy as well. Because it’s impossible for Elissa to speak to EVERYONE in the new 7th (no matter how hard she tries), our field team has been hard at work trying to reach voters where they are. So far, they’ve knocked 20,506 doors, made 174,855 phone calls, and held 19 town hall style events.
Because Elissa doesn’t accept corporate PAC money, we’re only able to pull this massive voter outreach program off thanks to the generosity of our grassroots supporters. Contributions help us distribute materials, make hard signs, and hire more field organizers. As we head into the final stretch, anything you could send our way helps us scale this program even further. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220927&amount=28]

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=992%2E61531%2EFuFl8B)
Hello,
Will you adopt a Vermont county? (Yes, you heard that right!)
Our team has been working around the clock building a people-powered coalition to elect Peter Welch as our next senator from Vermont. From Chittenden County to Windham, Peter is criss-crossing the state on our Welch Wagon 14 County Tour to earn the votes of as many Vermonters as possible.
This is no small undertaking, and absolutely none of what we’ve accomplished would be possible without your support. But with just six weeks left until Election Day, we’re making sure we’re doing _everything_ we can to reach _every_ single voter in _every_ single pocket of Vermont.
[**With a small donation today, you can fuel our campaign’s Get Out The Vote efforts in a Vermont county. Even $5 (seriously, just $5!) funds yard signs, phone calls, text messages, door knocks, and ads to spread Peter’s progressive vision for Vermont and our country far and wide. Can you donate right now to adopt one of our 14 counties?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4373?t=3&akid=992%2E61531%2EFuFl8B)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

Peter’s career has been about finding solutions despite our perceived differences, and he’s done it the _Vermont Way_ —by listening more than talking. He’s choosing to spend his time on the trail listening and learning about the issues that matter to Vermonters. And he’s hearing the same thing over and over again: **people are tired of the constant gridlock in Washington.**
We’re on a mission to give the people of Vermont a reason to vote in just six weeks’ time (with early voting already underway!), a reason to engage with our movement, and a reason to believe in Vermont’s future. But if we’re going to reach every single voter in the state, we’ll need every resource at our disposal from grassroots supporters like you.
[**Your donation will reach voters across Vermont — no matter their zip code, no matter where they come from. Please rush over $5 or whatever you can to adopt a county right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4373?t=7&akid=992%2E61531%2EFuFl8B)

# THE WAR ON LOBSTER
| | | | | | This summer, if you were trying to find me while I was out on the campaign trail, you may have found me standing shoulder to shoulder with the men and women of Maine’s lobster industry. Whether it was attending a rally, hauling traps, or swimming from boat to boat, I was there to listen to the challenges that they were facing. It has been one of the top priorities of my campaign, and if elected, I will make our lobster industry a top priority in Washington as well.
---
|
---
Our iconic lobster fishery in Maine is in a struggle for its very survival – not against nature, but against determined human foes: out-of-state environmentalists, overreaching bureaucrats, and politicians more worried about walking the line than taking a stand. Friends, we can’t afford to let this continue, or the longstanding Maine tradition that started with fishing dories and Friendship sloops and became the world renown industry it is today, will be coming to an abrupt end. It doesn’t need to be this way.The recent “red listing” of our lobsters by the California-based Seafood Watch is only one tentacle of this spreading threat.Seafood Watch didn’t even bother debating the science when approached by representatives of our lobster industry. They don’t care that they have it wrong, they laugh at us for even trying to reason with them. They’re just following orders and dancing to the tune their funders are playing. These are people with deep pockets and powerful connections. And from the sound of it, they want Maine lobsters out of stores across America.Conservationists of the Right Whale have promoted fake science to push for stricter regulations from the federal government’s National Marine Fishery Service (NMFS) and the National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) over when, where and how Maine lobsterman can earn a living.As a result, the federal government is burdening our lobster fishery with increasingly stringent regulations, with too little time to comply. Many of these battles are now in the courts. But what all of this has made clear to me is we need a fighter down in Washington ready to push back against those who just aren’t paying Maine much regard.If elected, I will fight for you. I will work to review funding for these agencies and find like-minded senators willing to put a hold on all relevant nominees until we get the answers we deserve and make them take real facts into consideration.My opponent just hasn’t been showing up on this issue as she tries to walk the line, despite living on an island where so many families depend on the fishery for their livelihoods. She tries to balance the concerns of the real people in her district with those of well-heeled, out-of-state environmentalists, as the lobster industry is being regulated out of existence.We just can’t afford that anymore. What Washington needs to hear from Maine right now is that we have not yet begun to fight!
|

| | [**_Washington Free Beacon:_ Republicans Within Striking Distance in Deep-Blue Los Angeles District, Spelling Trouble for House Dems**](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0q5tE4lychtAAhggjKpt4I1dWaWyrP8CoQh4Etpc2szoXvxb39ia_6oQ3Np-w-esyvoRGDawOGpUwD9rltaLfL69v-lyI9uDtz4ykwckdJE67B_Q-BJXlZkAghI4fNwlllWsfUTIiHaHMlOeW-ev5HpiAekSkyt8MSLmL0b40DoSQvQlm4rQWNFlymq2OmSc-cWNvlwBF_GHlolUdvkDBwh8glCKr_SEMj01c8p2FHueEb0Fvp7UrfImO5v66mpfT2WzKd4aJDPmAdxfJtAzG8AEa-xMMwnptLUOSnJX2_f7p2P4gO4iUzAa3flb0mB60uJrDKoJ6L-TDgg1gqbciJ_s%3D) Republican congressional hopeful Matt Jacobs is within striking distance of his incumbent Democratic opponent in a deep-blue Los Angeles district, a revelation that could force the Democratic Party to spend in a race they expected to win handily. [Jacobs](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0q5tE4lychtAAhggjKpt4I1c5yA1LvrqHrnVcuI_RjHxtezIPI0lZcK7ZcO-0Kay38JGr3g9aubLMNuHFYYTO-0dhp1Gbx8T8z0MQa-LvtXBKUCNsHd2Z1upnSNuLvekVOFOyopZ3a3VB9sGh4Vr8gUfVSCl6NnGJmmXzRCKuZm3x2TXGh9tXuXfpKjbm-btmlxNkuylW58p3bRA9II5XXBzp87InScH7TCX3iw3EZ3mWWaZn4UtLVH4pNBfFYxp1AcbKPJCNOYkgiYyLVHRdp955oBBehvcrpJjIvPeF1zht), a former federal prosecutor, trails five-term congresswoman Julia Brownley (D., Calif.) by just 4.8 points in California's 26th Congressional District, a September [OnMessage poll](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0q7bvddd30-5pImnzd3kYy66Ty1kH9_cs_YCBRDQdhgPsbP5sXXsCpgAe9WStwVexpy1ItFVtJAm9pcz7JTKJZNwwhVFkhOoZpAFxbrHJr3tMHWoK7EFYj_Gja-9ZFizAyupuDs6xBXbZFUExO_IK6DflonSdWTpc-L-Fc4AtmJUnhtfkAgaIQf6gAOYvV2w54pOufwXrnzuZmExUakMwr9bF13EoHs_Pj-T-cLc2MSqC) obtained exclusively by the _Washington Free Beacon_ shows. While President Joe Biden won that district by a whopping 25 points two years ago, independent voters have since soured on Democrats as Americans face record-high inflation. Jacobs, for example, holds a 10-point lead over Brownley with independents, according to the poll. The survey also found that Brownley's unfavorable rating has [climbed 5 points](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0q7bvddd30-5pImnzd3kYy66Ty1kH9_cs_YCBRDQdhgPskZmF8xYQ7u3E-UCefeHAcjmR90QH4jQzeAojLrgBRVnybuxkw_f7difj63EC0LQNgWNRHpBtbdBBhjuKwemjn5TdqEgNGMRLcnYkJTMkcnR3YU2mzeiKwnsixpzAickqBYN75yB2tFPof7S0pS3j0LohFeE5XJJlfmkEIYAJ8eSmt_hcdahT4pK4LMP6CRNkn1-Ikk08p3k9YGpFTrVz9oeqX3rSFuV5GIfRAc-des8%3D) since March. Those findings will likely alarm House Democrats, who expected to cruise to victory in the liberal district, which includes portions of Los Angeles County. The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee does not include Brownley on its [list](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0q7TxrQL3bSHntPj0Hac8IScl8-nQwz30FtWZKPcCXWKD5UFyZUWC6UQf7ZBP4kJv4PP_EZ3HWtGGNr68391b3q5xkizOaELp-lRg_n25USWeh23UQTMMuKs2fIi5lXDO6zxULAAZ3jltIdqG_1moZL0N4IqF9MSIg14ZGaDHCrf_qT6Gt-VzzOTwzGu85vObdw%3D%3D) of vulnerable members, and election handicapper Cook Political Report does not consider Brownley's district to be competitive. But OnMessage's September poll shows otherwise, meaning Democrats could be forced to commit resources to defend Brownley as their partisan counterparts go on offense. The National Republican Congressional Committee [added Brownley](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0qy69glQLTHDghfrGSNimmlzggXzjjgrvdkyTvt_a9CxGcI8SVvnuVlTtF3vidFSinAPZvM9SWkiNYszCJs4frY0rjr_qFY5ogefJ-qsYVTY-C4d13ilT-p9KQvU5MgW5ZtAcJqFlLTvIJv7WNFLGEFQAr4YooNLltcqq2Jiux0-_NAReAG7mimkdzH-LlFHgzblguInqXCHot6FQai-OexK7ZNVUaUm4Spz-Jc7YeLseHfF2-fA2amYuzzm7cpY_dvvOC3SH0cYvJOBPyo4tFlG1601mCMsZ7jrpidWQ3Kn0) to its target list in March and is working to flip four other California seats. Republicans have reason to believe they can win in once-longshot Golden State districts. According to a March Public Policy Institute of California poll, just [46 percent](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=1587397849a14280ab0974fe17a15581&_e=DLHJ01FQt5Pg4F82AKU0q26WA01KNPDcZ68ajILZ8u7zT7xwG0y6-qI1tJeAGfj1xAW_QTjcECOyNAidIPKLmt3w7S2Lelsn-1DEYzy_6Vdk9OUdVi93p0TSc6QSdeDJlw29Wz6sRxPAWD6_nAEN1i_vQ8uaB8yom9QB-6tQrK5PWdlqPc8futpdblcJ1OZ8J2e0fDGYRXSIfJ0Qs1TfeKy2B81T1cmPMsgVJnkEh2jy2FDnsng1YGdq7VfTarTP_pnIdVH_8ALqpIovRZ7sOtikfUBozi90mHOtuXAoH12JV6YuwQ9aMGcchm80N01A) of likely California voters approve of Biden, compared with 51 percent who disapprove. Those numbers marked a 19-point skid in just one year—in a 2021 poll from the same group, Biden enjoyed the support of 65 percent of likely California voters. Four California Republicans, meanwhile, flipped blue seats to red in 2020, even as Biden won the state by 29 points. "Brownley's low name ID, the poor perception of local Democrats, and a tied generic ballot show that this race will continue to be competitive and can narrow in the final stretch," OnMessage's poll states. "As Jacobs is winning over independents, Brownley is struggling to consolidate younger voters and college-educated voters. This seat deserves attention as Election Day nears." The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee did not return a request for comment.

We talked about how the day went and what’s on the top of our minds. Don spoke about our time together over the past 19 years and how much our lives have changed. And how, in some ways, they’ve stayed the same, like how united we are on what’s at stake with Don’s campaign. **We know that Don’s in the most extraordinary political fight of his life, our lives, and our country’s future.** Ultra-MAGA extremist Republicans are destroying our democracy, as evident by the January 6 insurrection, suppressing voters with voter roll purges, and creating unnecessary barriers for people to register to vote. We can’t let this continue, and _we must fight back this November to restore confidence in our political process._ We cannot afford to fall short of the campaign’s end-of-quarter fundraising goal, so I wanted to ask you directly if you can step up today. | | Friend, last Sunday night on the debate stage, Mike Flood avoided every opportunity to define where he stands on the issues. **If Mike won’t make his stances clear, then allow me to do it for him:** _Mike Flood said he supports “common-sense abortion regulation,” yet he was an _original co-sponsor of the trigger bill here in Nebraska_ which would have banned abortions **without exception for rape or incest.** In his answer, he tried to deflect his draconian abortion stance by painting Patty as an abortion extremist. In hers, Patty made clear that she believes in abortion that is “safe, legal, and rare.”_ _When asked how he would tackle inflation in Congress, Mike Flood was quick to point to the “billions and trillions of dollars in federal spending since Biden took office,” yet he offered**no actual answer to the question.** Meanwhile, Patty answered by reaffirming her support for lowering Affordable Care Act premiums and prescription drug costs._ _When prompted to explain his position on President Biden’s plan to cancel $10,000 of student debt for low-income borrowers, Mike Flood asked “Why should an electrician and a waitress pay off the debt for a Ph.D. student or graduate?” once again offering**no actual answers.** In contrast, Patty explained her support for capping interest rates on student loans, expanding the Pell Grant program, and making public colleges more affordable._ **Folks, if Mike Flood can’t answer one moderator’s yes or no questions about his plans for our district, why should we expect him to have any solutions in Congress?** He’s already proven that he’s willing to put his party over the well-being of our people, and it’s about time we hold him accountable for it. Patty Pansing Brooks and Mike Flood are going to take the debate stage one final time on **KLKN Channel 8 this Sunday at 5:00.** This is voters’ last chance to compare candidates before the polls officially open, and Patty is ready to show our district that she’s the only candidate in this race who is armed with _solutions_ — not mud to sling. **[Patty is working overtime to gear up for her last chance to reach new and undecided voters, but we need your help. Joe Biden shut down the construction of that wall. In doing so, he invited thousands of migrants and a steady flow of dangerous drugs and criminals to stream through the border gap that he’s chosen to leave open. _It’s a perfect illustration of President Biden’s failure._ **He created this crisis. But we have the power to fix it. ** We have the ability to once again secure our border and end the crisis of immigration. I know because that’s exactly what we achieved in four short years under the Trump-Pence administration. Advancing American Freedom even laid out the steps to fix this crisis in our Freedom Agenda. _All it takes is leadership dedicated to putting American safety FIRST. _ _Peter, do you have the will to make it happen?_ If so, I need you to chip in today to help us close the border.

name: Kari Lake
subject: we hear a lot about “outsiders” ➡
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)
---
| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. We're seeing that now with the border crisis, rising inflation, failing schools, and growing distrust in every American institution. Those on the inside can't fix what's broken. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r) _**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)
---
[**I 'M WITH KARI: SECURE THE BORDER >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)
---
Sincerely,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424914:J9pkHMVNN:m:1:3331421248:0214A294608C729759AB9624AAE7F849:r)

**Kari Lake** _Candidate for Arizona Governor_

Think about that, friend. We’re in the final stretch of this campaign and Donald Trump is coming to Michigan to rally his base for Kristina Karamo.
